I slipped up MANY times but the more that I stayed with the program, used all the tools provided, the easier it became. I make time every evening to do my daily tasks and use meditations almost daily. The community that you can become a part of is not only inviting, but they have been there too. You’re not alone. If you’re thinking about quitting or cutting back for any reason, I would highly recommend Reframe. They changed my life.

To Reframe: Thank You — I don’t rate or comment on apps because that’s stupid. So this is not a rating or review, but a thank you letter.   You helped me save my own life. I tried weekly meetings (Deity, non-deity). I’m a science guy so I wanted to prove how stupid the Deity meeting was. Glug Glug.   The science guy one was better, but then COVID and and virtual weekly meetings? Glug Glug Glug Glug Glug.  So this is the app for the science guy/gal who hates this booze addiction but can’t get enough booze. To my fellow science nerd/addicts: please read Never Enough by Judith Grisel, at least the booze chapter (Chapter 1, “The Hammer). She is one of us. She gets it  Reframe gets it too. A daily self check, if nothing else. And also readings and quotes that are perfect for science minded folks like us. Every day. If you want to get better, make the investment.   It costs $ dollars. I don’t even know. The money is insignificant compared to the daily self-check. And the knowledge that I may have just accidentally saved my own life.   At the meetings they pass the hat around. Maybe it’s me but everybody sees if it’s a 1, 5, 10, 20. I don’t do that any more. You were worth every penny up front and in hindsight I would have paid 10x more.   I hope that someone at Refresh sees this for the next update:  If you’re cringing at the cost because it’s obviously a chunk of $, I would like to help you if I can. I don’t know how that would work but the internet is a magical place.   Maybe this is an App review after all. 5 stars. Would recommend. Tell your friends.   Thank you.

Worked for me — I spent more on alcohol every couple of weeks than this app costs for the year. Let's get that out there first thing. I did the 30 day trial for ten bucks or whatever to give it a full go. I initially started on the cutback track, but all that did was show me how much I was actually drinking and how difficult it was. A few weeks in, I decided to do a 30 day dry challenge. It was so difficult, that when I made it, I decided to never drink again. The app is so easy to use and teaches how alcohol affects every system of your body. My life has improved dramatically since choosing to end my relationship with alcohol. Every facet of my life is better: work, family, health (mental and physical), spiritual. If you are questioning your relationship with alcohol, give this a try. Swap the money you'd spend on drinks for a one year subscription to this app. What can it hurt?

Something this important should not have bugs — It is a great concept and the execution is fine, but I decided not to continue my premium trial as my app would not track my start days, update my daily tasks, or allow my to create a forum profile. I really relied on this app for a few weeks, but times that I needed it most often were when the bugs would start. Updated and redownloaded multiple times still with freezing pages and unusable “daily lessons” that would never load. I usually do not care about a few bugs but a resource that is based on such an intense and time-sensitive addiction should be completely functional and frankly it is really irresponsible to compromise people’s well-being through simple bugs.. I know this app is not meant to be a total support system, but the inconsistency of its features is wild. Wish I could have had a better experience. Not going to start relying on an app that I don’t know if it will load or not when I need it.

You don’t have to be Sober Alone — Reframe has kept me from drinking with an incredible amount of supportive people and information. The app is very engaging with opportunities and challenges to earn points, coins and awards just for reading informative material which support your cut back journey or your sobriety.  I’ve done dry January three years in a row using the reframe app.  I’ve found kind support from others who are also using the app.  New things this year were options to journal, videos, recordings of easy meditations and the option to join a group. The best part for me is being in a community of like minded folks with the same goal.  I’ve been to AA meetings and this is not that. There are group Zoom meetings, however I prefer not to use that option.  I may try one though out of curiosity because I have positive experiences with everything else within reframe.

Empower yourself to stop the madness! This works!!! — I can not give this app enough kudos. The app itself is amazing between all the helpful science based info, variety of coping skills and different types of support (both written on the forum and live on the community meetings). I feel like something greater than myself… part of a community that has ridden the same struggle bus. The customer support is on point. Kayla and crew get right back to you…showing up when you need them. They ask for, listen to and follow through/ try their best to follow through on member suggestions. If you have been feeling like your alcohol use is a bit out of hand or completely taken over your life, try this. Even paying for it, what do you have to lose? I know I blew so much money on alcohol that gave me so many losses 🙈. At least this is a shot at some gains!!! Ty Kayla and Reframe community 💗🙏

Could Not Have Stopped Drinking Without Reframe — I haven’t wanted to stop drinking for over 10 years now. I even downloaded & began using the app over a year ago but knew in my heart I wasn’t ready. Once I was finally sick & tired of being a slave to alcohol & scary side effects I was beginning to experience, I started again & began to seriously use the Reframe app. I love the supportive community & coaches, the group Zoom meetings (during which you can just listen & not be seen or heard if you prefer), the training modules, podcasts, meditations, craving tools, etc. There is so much available to help you become alcohol free. I didn’t want to drink on New Year’s Eve. There was a Zoom group meeting for several hours. A few hundred people were participating in the meeting. It helped me immensely knowing that many people all over the world are also choosing to live without alcohol.

Has made such an impact — I downloaded this app ages ago, but didn’t use it as I didn’t want to pay tbh. A few days into dry January I reopened it and started using it. This has made such an impact, and I’m so glad I paid for it. It’s slowly changing my mindset towards drinking, and with how much cognitive dissonance I have around alcohol - it’s not easy.   There are loads of features, lots of things you can log and reflect on, courses, a community. It’s has made a massive impact on my sober journey.   To the developers and designers - I do think some of the UX is a little confusing. Like, where to log drinks and emotions etc. if it hasn’t come up on the daily check list, took me a minute to find. Also in settings I kept getting stuck on that page because I didn’t realize I could scroll down - might need a scrolling bar on the side so it’s clear. But otherwise is great 😁

Worth every penny — I strongly encourage anyone struggling with being in a cycle of overdoing it with alcohol to get this app and use it every day.  It doesn’t matter if what that looks like for you is 5, 10, or even 1 drink per day, or just 5, 10, or 1 drink per week.  If you are in a cycle where you feel badly about your use of alcohol, this app is for you.  In fact, this app can help anyone who is struggling in a relationship or feeling positive about themselves, even if they don’t drink.  That’s because it gets to the heart of why we are struggling.  It never makes you feel badly or judged, it just helps you look inside to understand what’s going on.  I am approaching the end of my year subscription and believe that I will continue into a second year because it helps me so much.  I’m living a happier, more authentic life since starting this journey with Reframe.

Do not hesitate to purchase this app!!! — I know you read this all the time, “I am never one to write a review !” Well I’m not one to EVER write a review however, this one is worth writing! If you are looking to totally give up alcohol or just cut back (I gave it up totally) this is the app you want to download immediately!! it is based in science, it will tell you why you do what you do, and there are so many tools associated with this app, that if you truly want to change your life, you can do it with reframe!!! This is a game changer. I am 136 days alcohol free and I  truly do not think I would be this far, free of alcohol, if I did not have this app!! When you know better you do better and this app will tell you a lot of the why you do it and how to undo that why!!!!  I personally guarantee you that you will never regret not drinking and never regret getting this app!!

Refram Changed My Life!!! — I honestly never thought that I would be able to stop drinking until I got this app. It started with the Check In’s and I found people that were doing what I wanted to do and showed me that it was indeed possible to start. Then I started posting in the forums and that helped my try to stop and gave me encouragement. Finally I decided to stop and joined a private group within the app and that helped a lot because I have the same small group to help remember why I’m doing this and help support me. As I started going through withdrawals the daily health updates helped me to understand what I was going through and accept them and not quit because I could keep track of how long they would last. All in all at the end of the day it’s up to you but this app is definitely a huge tool to help you get there if you try!

Reframe Reframes my Life — I have spent many years feeling like I should address my drinking. It was never such a bad issue that I felt I had to join AA or really get serious about it, but Reframe helps me to see that  this wasn’t the way I should see it. Reframe has shown me the incredible impact steady drinking has been having on my daily life and health and now encourages me as I keep it out of my life and enjoy the benefits. It gives me all the reminders, all the support, and a lot of community and helpful tips. It’s been a real game changer. The science-based approach is so effective - so much more effective than other approaches. I’m just at the point where I have to decide if I am going to continue with the paid subscription after the complementary month, and I am going to continue because I love the new healthy life I’ve got, and I know the continued support will be helpful.

Wonderful App! — I was struggling with suffocating stress and my drinking was going up slowly month after month.  I joined Reframe after several recommendations from my sister.  Wow, did she under sell it.  This app and all its tools, education, zoom meetings and support is a full program whether you want to cut back or go alcohol free.  In less than four months I am back to a moderate healthy relationship with alcohol.  I love their approach that there is no such thing as failure. The coaches and community always build you up as you go up and down on your personal journey with your own personal goals without judgement.  Even though I am happy with where I am at, I will continue with reframe because of the daily learnings, the friends I’ve made all over the world and the diverse meetings and topics that challenge me on all levels daily.  Thank you Reframe! Wendy Orange County, CA

Completely changed my relationship to alcohol — I am thrilled with the results from Reframe but my journey has not been a straight line. I downloaded it in January while hoping to cut back which I did for the month (no drinking during the week but no limits ok weekends). I felt better but stress and other triggers came up in Feb and March and by April I found myself back to old habits. In May I realized I needed to go back and try again and thanks to the forums, I decided to go a set period of time with no alcohol. It was great advice and with the support of the members in the program I found a much better way forward. I have felt so much better the past few months and am drinking about 90% less than I was. All the tools, videos, games to help overcome cravings and the teachings are terrific but the forums are really helpful. You will go through this with a community.

Live virtual meetings and science — I’ve tried a few different apps and Reframe is what I’ve selected because they give you a daily task that takes about 15 minutes and it’s filled with the science behind alcohol that I’d never read about before. There are also podcasts and blogs you can listen to and a couple different live virtual meetings each day you can attend. This is the only app I’ve seen that has an optional live virtual meeting component which I find helpful. You don’t have to have your camera on and you don’t have to speak if you don’t want. I’m 8 days in so far and have cut my number of drinks in half. I can’t wait to see how I continue to progress! Update:  50 days in and I’ve cut my number of drinks down by at least one third.  It’s hard work, but I’m doing it with the amazing support and endless tools of the reframe app.  Yay!!!!

Impressed and Grateful — I was very hesitant about this app because after all of the questions it makes you sign up for a subscription. After I declined I went on my olde drunken merry way until about a week later I was looking for a way out again. I would get daily emails from Reframe in which one offered a free 1 month trial… so here we are. After 10 full days sober (a lot of thanks to this app) I will absolutely be subscribing when my trial is done. This app isn’t just an app, it’s a community where people from ALL over the world are going through EXACTLY what I am. It’s nice to check in everyday and read the articles and attend the Zoom calls. Highly recommended this for a life line and a piece of mind if you’re looking to cut back or go completely sober. You won’t regret it, as long as you are willing to make the change. Peace all 🫶❤️

Enlightening and positive — I’ve been using this for a few months and it has really been helpful to me, right now more so than any other program such as AA or celebrate recovery. Not that those are not helpful, and I will probably return to one of them, but recently I have needed to understand more about what underlies my cravings and why I’ve had such a hard time cutting back on my own. This app has done that for me and much more. The forum is really great, I can be honest and raw and know that I will not be judged and there will be a whole lot of people who identify with me. So it’s easy for people to support each other here. I can’t recommend it enough. The meetings that are available are also very useful and timely. Daily tasks have been so enlightening, really helping me understand and embrace my journey to change my relationship with alcohol forever.

Best quit / moderation program so far — For those with an interest in neuroscience and who can’t quite stomach the “higher power” approach, Reframe is an essential support tool for building better habits around alcohol. Reframe deconstructs mental models and cultural narratives around alcohol, similar to Alan Carr’s Easy Way to Quit Smoking. With this program, you will not dwell on your failures or wallow in shame, and you will not obsess with the pleasure you are losing if you choose to quit — instead, you will learn why your brain works the way it does, how it can be changed, and what pleasures there are in re-wiring your brain. I used it along with reading Atomic Habits and embracing the small pleasures of gamification: gradually building new wellness habits with easy-onboard fitness apps (Fitbod, Apple Fitness+), nutrition apps (MealLime, Lumen), and sleep apps (Oura). 2 months into the program and utterly enjoying myself.

♥️♥️♥️ — I love this app!  I was recommended this app from a friend/coworker because I was embarking on abstaining from alcohol for the unforseeable future. I love this app!  I don’t really struggle with addiction but have always enjoyed a good buzz socially.  Reframe offers so much but my favorite is the education piece.   I loved learning what alcohol actually does to the body, beyond that I love all the tools that it gives you not only to be alcohol free but to deal with life and the thought processes we share as humans.  I’ve surpassed my 90 day goal and want to remain 95% alcohol free for the rest of my life. Even though my goal has been completed, I’ve decided to continue on and finish my courses however long that will take I’m unsure but it doesn’t matter because the information is completely valid and I want to learn!  Love you Reframe team!  Keep up the amazing work!  Stacey

It really works — This is the best app I’ve ever used (any app). Not only does reframe get the science right on neuroplasticity and brain based healing, but they’ve also created an app that is valuable, usable, beautiful, interactive and fun. The AI coach is exceptional. I felt like I was chatting with my therapist. Weird, but so helpful. In terms of effectiveness, it’s working for me. Example: We don’t keep alcohol in the house. Except when we host parties. Normally the left over alcohol would be consumed by me nightly until it’s gone. After our last party I had enough and started reframe. Even with all this alcohol within arms reach, I’ve not wanted to touch it. I told my wife to get rid of it. It’s still here after a week and I’m still dry and loving it!! Please try this if you’ve tried other methods without success. I bet you 100 recoins it will help! God bless.

Pay money to have an app Tell you to the same thing over and over. — Reframe is expensive for what it is. I am using it because it keeps track of my daily drinking and its forum and articles helped me at first but now I find the whole thing frustrating. I pay almost 25 bucks a month to have it tell me to solve all my problems by journaling, exercising, talking to a friend, getting a hobby or to reexamine negative thoughts/meditation. That is good advice but you can only get that same advice so many times before you realize that you might as well just save your 25 bucks and take a walk every day. They offer personal coaches but the cost of those is high and probably out of most people’s means. The app also offers daily challenges which gave me something to do at first but after completing a couple and losing 10 days progress randomly on one… the whole thing seems like a why bother. Thanks for keeping track of all the money I’m saving reframe. I’ll save even more without you.

Great app for alcohol reduction — I’ve been straggling with alcohol for a couple of years and every time I decide to cut down my alcohol consumption I always end up drinking alcohol again the same way it was or even worse. I don’t think I have extreme problems with alcohol, but I’m in the point that it is bothering me not being able to control the amount of alcohol I drink. So, I tried the Reframe app a first time for a month and I was being able to cut back my alcohol consumption. Then I decided to cancel my subscription and I went back to my old self and I started drinking again and this time more often and more quantities. Finally, I put myself the choice of join AA meetings or stay committed to the Reframe app. As you see, I’m writing this long review and telling my story that the app has helped me and has being my Remote AA support system.

Best money I’ve ever spent — I spent the better part of a decade knowing I needed to quit drinking. During that time I tried and failed to quit through many different strategies. AA, therapy, rehab, and a number of pharmacological options never worked. Even a combination of all of that didn’t work.   My biggest problem was that none of those things helped me change the way I thought about alcohol and drinking. I “wanted” to drink because, despite how much I knew it took away from my life, a part of me still felt like it added something valuable. Escape, apathy, or just numbness were what it gave me. And plenty of times, that was exactly what I was looking for.   Reframe helped me take all of the things I already knew about alcohol (plus many things I didn’t) and use them to change my mindset. I consider myself open-minded and open to change, but I also know that my more deep-seated beliefs can be hard to budge. I realized that my relationship with and my entire thought process regarding alcohol were seated very deep. This app changed all that.  My desire to drink has vanished. The only emotions I have toward alcohol are the occasional mild repulsion and the overwhelming relief that I don’t want to poison myself anymore.   I’ve been sober for almost 3 months, and that may not seem like much, but it’s the second longest I’ve gone without drinking in 18 years. The longest was 4 months on a combination of therapy and meds and I struggled through every second of it. These 3 months I’ve not only abstained from drinking, I haven’t had a single craving.   I’ll keep buying the subscription if only to keep this company in business so it can give many others what it gave me. Freedom from alcohol.

Reframe — I am so grateful I stumbled upon Reframe!! I’ve tried many ways to slow my drinking and my goal is to be alcohol free!! This app is awesome there is support 24/7 there are great motivational tips and reads, journaling and ways to connect with others feeling the same way you do and going through situations and life experience much like me and will chat with you and encourage you along the way. I am a private person with extreme anxiety so being face to face with others in group settings was just not working for me this gives me the comfort of my own home, my time and my terms it has helped me be brutally honest with myself! My advice if your feeling alone, and like you’ve tried everything else don’t give up keep searching dive into Reframe there is so much help and resources at what ever stage your are there is help!!

Great and helpful info but app is glitchy — I just completed the free trial and found the daily assistance and science backed articles so helpful that I purchased the year membership.  The issue I have is that very often the app doesn’t work at all.  It’s just a white screen and the info never loads. I have to go back in multiple times before it will load if it loads at all.  I don’t have this issue with any other spots I use.  I reported the issue, I deleted and re-added the app, I signed out as instructed but now it isn’t letting me sign back in.  This type of thing could be a trigger for some people.  I love the information and the layout of the app.  Plus all the resources they make available. When I’m able to get in it’s great.  It’s just very frustrating that it’s such a challenge to get in almost every time I open it.  Wish they could fix the issue.

Great app for cessation or moderation — This is only my first week using Reframe but I’m definitely going to continue to use it after the free trial. I have tried (and failed) year after year to go a whole month without drinking but this year I really feel hopeful. They have many resources that help users understand addiction and how alcohol affects the brain and body. There are tasks to complete each day that are informative and useful. I look forward to using the app everyday and I love the journal entries. I am able to get to the core reason of why I drink and I’m able to view my alcoholism in a new and enlightened way. I’m excited to continue dry January (maybe longer) with this app as my guide! Highly recommend if you’d like to stop or even just cut back on drinking. It’s so worth it, your body and mind will thank you

Very Relevant App — I would highly recommend the reframe app for anyone trying to cut back or quit alcohol. I have tried other apps, but have found this one is much more helpful in so many ways. The daily tasks are relevant and they don’t take much time. The insights are very positive And motivating during your journey to quit alcohol. This app provides so much more than just a counter for your days sober. The many resources in the app make it easy to find something each day to help you where you need it most. I find the communities communications to be much more positive than other apps that I have tried. I have only used the app for every month, but I have been diligent each day to complete my tasks because I really enjoy the information and exercises and find it extremely relevant and helpful.

I have found the help I need in Reframe — I read about the Reframe app in an article about ways to quit or cut back on alcohol use. I downloaded the app and purchased the annual subscription. It’s been close to two weeks since that purchase and I'm so glad I did!  I have experienced immediate benefits as a result of the Reframe app, specifically results that have improved my mental, physical, and emotional health. This has been accomplished through the incredibly supportive way the app educates you about then affects of alcohol and the supportive exercises Reframe offers to strengthen your resolve. This is done through goal setting, inspirational motivations, science-based articles, and positive affirmations. What I appreciate most is that it’s all done without being preachy. Thanks to the team at Reframe, I’m getting better and stronger every day.

Excellent!! — This app has been exceedingly helpful. I’ve cut back my alcohol use and feel much more balanced and in control when it comes to when and how much I drink. This app doesn’t feel hokey or like it’s trying too hard like others apps I’ve tried in the past have for help with dieting or mental health and I really appreciate that aspect of it. I’m a registered nurse even by profession and I know how harmful it is to drink in excess. I think sometimes we “forget” things we know when something we think is serving us as a coping skill is brought into question, and this app has helped to remind me. Anyway, if you’re looking to cut back, quit, or just be more mindful, give this a try. I’m always excited to do the daily lessons and log my drinks and see how much money and empty calories I’ve saved for the week!

Life changing! — This App accidentally got me sober and I couldn’t be happier. I just wanted to take a break from alcohol on my “staycation” in August  (like I did every year around October) and stumbled upon this App. I made it part of my daily “spa at home” routine. When the week was up I was enjoying the App (it is very easy to use and doesn’t require much time) so I stayed with it. After a month I switched from the “sober curious” option to the “sober” path. And I basically never went back. I have found the xtra day in the week, my skin and my bank account love me and this App helped me navigate the entire process. I almost felt cheated that I’d wasted so much time to alcohol…and guess what…the App saw that coming and helped me through that also. Give it a try, you really have nothing to lose and so much to gain.

So far so good! — I’m 40 days in drink free with one of the many times I’ve tried to stop drinking alcohol.  What I like about reframe is that it makes me focus everyday on stopping and brings in Health issues and neuroscience.  While I’m pretty aware of these issues, in the past I used to eventually find a way to ignore them (like, “My brain’s recovered now, no reason I can’t have a drink.  Then that one drink would lead into another two years of after work drinking).  With a daily dose of reminders I have not yet rationalized myself into drinking.   The journaling aspect is good.  I’ve been meaning to journal on my own, but have never gotten to it. There’s plenty of support in the app as well.  People you can contact, social media and classes.  A complete and well done app.  If it saves your life, it’s priceless, just like you!

Excellent overall — I decided to try this app after a known celebrity recommended it on Instagram.  My goal was not to stop drinking completely but instead I wanted to reduce the toxic load on my body and have a chance to drop some pounds.  The app allow you to select to stop 100% or reduce to x-amount of drinks per week.  I started by saying one drink per week.  I mostly follow that except for the occasional 2 drinks because of business dinners.  The daily readings are easy to finish up your day with and I was pretty amazed to read just what kind of damage is done to various parts of our body because our systems have to work so hard to flush, well, poison from our body.  It’s quite enlightening but never feels like the articles are preaching to you.  I would recommend after using 70 days.

Really Helpful — There are not a ton of small tools out there to help one stop drinking or cut down on drinking, barring AA and the big rehab move.  Another powerful tool in the toolbox: for me, the app brings something to my routine, which is important to me when I’m trying to stop drinking, by way of small and interesting learnings, motivations, support and tracking. I also love that it brings a lot of science and is a regular reminder of the negative physio effects of alcohol.  It keeps me focused on what I’m gaining when I don’t drink and how alcohol is harming me in a way that is interesting and not over bearing (small, bite-sized daily readings).  Well laid out.  Well done reframe folks!  The only improvement I crave is that if we don’t check into reframe, I wish it would pick up where we left off and not count those as non-drinking days.

I didn’t think I’d get this much success from an App! — I’ve been seeing the advertisements on Instagram about Reframe and was intrigued because I saw all the amazing reviews and saw that even celebrities have had success with it, so with a 1 week free trial, I decided why not!  I started to experience burnout towards the end of my Army career and started to turn to alcohol to cope.  It definitely numbed me to get through some of the more unpleasant parts of my career, but I soon began to realize that maybe I needed a change.  I realized that after 16 years in the Army, it was no longer a lifestyle that me or my family could tolerate.  I got out thinking it would help with the burnout, but then COVID hit, and I was a healthcare employee at a Level 1 Trauma center.  Needless to say, the burnout continued and so did my nasty little habit.    The nasty little habit never interfered with my job but it did start impacting my relationships, and I was concerned it would eventually interfere with my job performance.  I went to see my doctor about getting on naltrexone but this was a very long process.  I needed labs and follow ups and it would be months before he could decide what to do with me.  Mental health was a 6 month wait for an appointment, so that option was out.    Reframe has been a lifesaver.  The first week went so well that I am sticking with it.  I have been able to change my relationship with alcohol so that I can still enjoy it, but responsibly on special occasions, which is what I wanted.  The neuroscience that it teaches you is invaluable and so important for the first few days when you’re trying to cut-back.  It gives you the tools and help you need and none of the shame and judgement you don’t need.

What REFRAME has helped me with… — I’m a heavy drinker…15-25 drinks per week…since high school (stopped for 8 yrs cold turkey when dad died)…drinking was “cool” in high school…it heloed me “fit in” and i got used to it helping me socialize.  I’ve been able to “ manage” it on and off throughout my life…for me, it most definitely is a temporary stress relief and reward for getting through stress… But its been a constant “battle” which is a constant stress point.   I am very happy, most of the time, my world looks up to me, depends on me, i love my life…accept for how much I drink and the consequences from drinking.  I don’t sleep well. I don’t feel well. I don’t perform as well as I could, brain quickness, fatigue, anxiety, temper, motivation, etc are all ever present because of my drinking heavily & consistently.  REFRAME has been there for me every day to help understand the real consequences and to build a strategy to improve and manage my relationship with alcohol.  I’m drinking half what I was before committing to REFRAME! The concept of managing your relationship with alcohol vs quitting entirely is brilliant for me! The content is incredibly helpful, interesting and motivating.  I strongly recommend signing up for a year. Its a “no brainer” in terms of return on investment!  Thank you REFRAME

The only one that’s worked for me — I’m not looking to quit 100% (yet?) but I knew I needed to cut back. I decided to try Reframe for “damp January.” The app made it easy and fun. What I love most are the daily bite-sized lessons about you gain be reducing alcohol, and mindset hacks to overcome cravings and navigate problematic situations like parties. They also have awesome community features like chat and live meetings, though you don’t have to attend those if that’s not your thing. I was doing so well I continued in February and beyond. It becomes a habit to check in on the app and it’s gratifying to see your progress every days and  over time. That said, something that’s easy to do is also easy not to do…and I fell off my virtuous cycle a couple of months later and am now coming back. *You* still have to do the work!

Best Decision I Ever Made — This App and the community are amazing! I can’t tell you how many times I tried to stop drinking throughout my adult life, but I just didn’t have the tools that I needed to be able to do it.  I’ve been on the App a little over 3 years, and I am now 880 days Alcohol Free - that’s two years and 3 months!!!! (In my first year, I made it to 198 days and then slipped up, but I had learned a lot, and I got back on my feet and never looked back). I can’t tell you what a miracle this has been. I had pretty much given up and figured that I was meant to die hopelessly addicted to alcohol. Then Reframe showed up on my social media, and I decided to give it one more try. I am so grateful to Reframe and to the algorithm that brought the App to my attention. Miracles do happen, after all 🩷

this app helped me change my life — 20 years of heavy drinking and had tried stopping by myself a few times, gave AA two chances and knew it wasn’t for me. I needed help in my journey of stopping drinking and in addition to a support system I set up, I chose this app based on word of mouth. Reframe truly helped me stopped drinking. It’s not a magic cure, you are reading this review because you already know you need a change and there isn’t a magic solution. It’s got a great program you can choose and use like a menu with no pressure. It’s also super convenient, uber discreet, and a truly safe space. It wasn’t the only thing I used, but it was the main one. One year later, I am continuing my subscription because it worked for me. I now count in years being alcohol free in part thanks to Reframe.

It works, from the inside, out… — I’ve been using this app for about 3 months now.  Bottom line is that I’ve reduced my alcohol intake quite a bit.  Reframe combines information about the psychological reasons behind my relationship with alcohol with the knowledge of the physical consequences of misusing it, in such a comprehensive way!  This has been a remarkable adventure. I have learned more about myself and the way I was choosing to let alcohol slowly take a more and more prominent role in my life than I ever have before - by far.  The result has been that I am armed with an incredible set of tools with which I make better decisions about where and when I consume alcohol. I have learned, through the process taught by Reframe that I was relying far too much on the “quick fix” that I’d been looking for way too often. And now that I know what the physical consequences are for using alcohol as much as I was, I have been able to cut WAY back.  It’s fun, engaging and I really look forward to each day’s interaction with the app.  There is a LOT of support and many resources from which to pull from, and it makes the process comfortable and inspiring!  I highly recommend the Reframe app, best money I’ve spent in a very long time…

A Game Changer — I joined Reframe in support of my husband’s quitting journey but I learned so much that helped me to grow as a person. The course is manageable and the information is well researched and presented in an interesting way. It completely reframed my own thinking about alcohol and helped me to become self aware of not only my unhealthy relationship with alcohol but also other aspects of my life that have been holding me back. I feel that absolutely anyone who lives in this world today would benefit from making the time for Reframe. By the way, in six months my husband was a new man and after a year he chooses to prioritize his health and happiness by choosing to abstain from alcohol. A total turnaround. Thank you, Reframe. I am deeply appreciative for the education and support you provide.

I’d be doing the same old things if it weren’t for Reframe — I wanted to break bad habits that I had developed over many years of drinking with dinner or every time I went out, and even when I stayed in. I was tired of feeling unhealthy all the time. I credit this app for keeping me accountable, educated and helping me develop new healthy habits instead of mindlessly continuing on the same old habit cycle. Every day I look forward to the daily tasks which are small bites that don’t take up a ton of my time. They are easy, and I have learned so much about the truth of what alcohol does to my body and brain, and Reframe has provided me with a wide variety tools for how to navigate so many situations that I worried I couldn’t navigate alcohol free. I am loving it and will continue with this app!

I have my issues with the app — free trial reminder doesn’t work — I tried the app with the free trial just to see if I would even use it. I can attest the app itself seems good and I can definitely see people benefitting from it easily.   That said, I toggled the reminder to notify me before my free trial ended and it never did. As much as it was a good app, I immediately forgot to use it. If you take shots, what is a “drink”? They only give you cocktail, beer and wine options. As a former bartender, a cocktail is generally 1 1/4oz to 1 1/2oz per drink. Cocktail was far too vague for me to feel I was accurately reporting and tracking my drinks per day/week numbers. Some people at home making cocktails just dump 3-4 shots per drink in! I mean that’s someone really “struggling” with being able to define the number of drinks they’re consuming. Is it one drink or four shots meaning four-ish drinks??   Anyway, even with notifications on, I literally signed up, checked the app out, and spent the free trial having this internal argument and never actually using it.   Well they just tried to charge me $120 for the entire year without actually reminding me the free trial was up, even though I toggled that.   Needless to say it’s cancelled and I deleted the app. How is someone struggling financially supposed to pay $120 after barely a week of seeing if it even works??? Must be nice to have that much disposable income.

Understand your addiction and change your relationship to it — Understand the science and personal ‘whys’ addiction and change your relationship to it through a multifaceted approach: learning, mindfulness practices, cultivating skill sets to prepare for noticing and responding to triggers, share in community support through forums and meetings (I haven’t personally tried the meetings), and more. Also they have a beta version of an AI chat assistant who is honestly more useful than my therapist (and smarter than chatgpt for mental health/addiction purposes). The ability to at any moment of distress send a message to this AI bot has changed the way I handle that distress and allows me to get the support I need without social anxiety or fear of burdening others being a barrier. I have recommended this appt to many people.

Extremely effective — I’ve tried to stop drinking many times through many means - will power, self-help, in patient, etc - this time I finally found something that works. The Reframe app worked for me. Will it work for everyone? Maybe not but worth a try. It uses science, support groups, daily assignments, reading, and cutting edge research to help.   You need to be ready to put the work in but it’s all there. There is a forum of like minded people ready to respond and help, an additional service of one on one coaching which I utilized which was amazing, and many other tools. The monthly fee? Worth it. Because I spent that amount and more each month in alcohol. After 100 days alcohol free I’m a different person. Give it a try and you’ll find people willing to help.

Very useful app — I decided to stop drinking because ofA routine blood test that showed elevated liver enzymes. I waited six weeks and they kept going up. I received further testing and nothing else is going on. I decided to stop alcohol for a while. I was a two glass a day of wine drinker and binge drank on social occasions. Anyway I am on day 17 and have been using this app. It is very informative and useful and a great daily check-in/reminder to help on this path. I would definitely recommend it and will continue using it for now. I quit smoking a year and a half ago and I know a lot of the strategies are the same. However I have been learning a lot more about alcohol use with this app. I have been feeling pretty amazing since stopping, even though it’s only been two weeks

Life changing app — I had seen the Reframe app pop-up a few times in my social media feeds. The message was basically, “get off the social media and start spending time improving your mental health.”  I finally downloaded it and am glad I did. I was sober four years but fell off the wagon after my divorce last year. I had been going back and forth with sobriety when I downloaded this app. It really helped me learn more about what was going on in my head (and heart) and how to better deal with the emotions. The daily exercises are fun, informative and the AI chat really helped you work through things.  I also like the calendar so you can see your progress. Highly recommend for anyone going through addiction or simply want to cultivate healthier habits.

Extremely Flawed and Frustrating — Grifter Scam!!!! This app is more interested in getting new subs and having you refer your friends than it is with helping you quit alcohol. The function of this app is wildly inconsistent. They clearly do not have their act together on the IT side. But on top of that many of the lessons texts are incomplete, or clearly still in draft form. The customer service dept, or whoever fields issue reports will not help with anything. (update: their response to this review is very typical of the gaslighting response they give when you bring attention to their mistakes, but they never actually do anything to fix them) After a few weeks every lesson essentially boils down to “exercise, do yoga, meditate, make strong connections.” Oh, and they make you earn “recoin” to access the material even though you paid over $100 for the app. Everything should be available up front at the start. At this point this app is my single BIGGEST trigger. Don’t waste your money or time.

Don’t worry, don’t wait — Reframe is the best thing I have ever done for myself and frankly it was just serendipity. I was chilling on a random Sunday night not feeling too great from all the drinking on Friday and Saturday. Nothing dramatic just more than what I wanted to and not for the first time. An ad came up while I was scrolling and it was talking about how your liver will process alcohol and then not be available to process the food that you eat. Since the pandemic I’d been having at least one drink while making dinner so that’s made a lot of sense to me why I wasn’t looking great even though I was eating good and exercising.   So I joined because of my liver and it ended up changing my life. I have learned so much and it isn’t all about 100 percent quitting or white knuckling. I truly helped me recondition my mind.  I also love my people in the Forum! Everyone is so supportive no matter where you are in the journey.   Don’t expend energy overthinking this. I’ve drank for 40 years and just went dry for Lent. It was way easier than even trying to go Monday through Thursday prior to the app. Just make the commitment do get the app and read the lessons every morning and log your drinks then see what happens

Not super helpful — I’m not sure about you but I grew up in an alcoholic family.. started drinking when I was 12 (my dad insisted I had a glass of champagne during xmas). Like most people these days, we want info quick and the fact that I have to read every lesson.. and I am not a reader.. bored after the second lesson and close it. No motivation to complete it, even with reminders. I wouldn’t say it’s engaging and I think people who drink, need to be engaged.. to help with the urge. Not what I expected from reading the reviews. I think the app could take it to the next lesson with at LEAST an audio book if not videos. Games/ puzzles would be a good addition as well. I’ve been to therapists and this all seems the same. It doesn’t help reading about the background of why you drink.. to a certain extent but I’ve been through all that before so what about this app is actually helping?? It’s boring but informational.. just not for me.

Reframe is worth it — I have read the reviews and I have to say that what they have said is true. They have covered  everything that I can think of. There is an AI advisor named Melody on this app and it’s amazing how many things she can come up with to help me.    I don’t think there is any avenue that Reframe hasn’t thought of. This might sound weird but I feel like whoever designed this app really cares about people with alcohol addiction. I look forward to the next day to find out the tasks that will be presented to me.    There is a progressive positive in giving up alcohol on a daily basis. I started feeling better about life in general one day at a time. Each day has been better and better. With this app, you’re not really alone you can turn to it and it strategies to help you get through cravings. There’s even a timer because cravings last 20 minutes,  they set it for you when you go to the strategies part of the app.  This is only a drop in the bucket. That’s why my heading is “it’s worth it” I’m not even mentioning ALL that there is to offer. Honestly, it’s more than worth it as far as how much it costs, just think of the money you’ll save anyway. Just do it!

Love Reframe! — I was a little skeptical about this app when I first saw it. But I began to read through some of the Information in the app and became very intrigued. I got the app and use it every day. The information is so concise ,thorough and has been very enlightening to me. The information really makes you Aware of what alcohol really is and how it affects you in so many ways. I’ve made other attempts to stop drinking but they did not Impact me the way that this app has. I know different things work for different people, but this has definitely helped me and I would recommend it. One other thing, if you’re serious about trying to cut back or stop drinking don’t be discouraged by some of the comments that you will see. Reframe is the real deal!

It really works — Reframe has helped me stay sober for 304 days now. It honestly taught me so much about myself and what alcohol truly does to our bodies. Checking in daily completing tasks is so satisfying and rewarding. Without this app I’m not sure I would still be sober. They also have tons of challenges that have pushed me even harder and groups you can join for support that way your not alone in your journey! I was able to find a group for my city which was pretty cool! There are even zoom chats you get hop on daily for a little extra support. This app has everything and more! I would highly recommend giving it a try if your trying to cut back or sober curious or trying to get sober! It really does work if you do the work!!!

Scam — I’m not sure how well the app works because I didn’t give it much of a chance. I will say they want your money though. I did the trial period and they tried to charge my apple account before the period was over, instead of charging my apple account where all of the other subscriptions get charged on an iPhone. I’ve never really dealt with Apple Pay and not sure on how to use it very well can’t figure out how to cancel their subscription on Apple Pay and they are still trying to charge me a week after I deleted my reframe account. I can’t find a number to call only through email. I re-uploaded the reframe app then re-sign in and tried to cancel the account again and it said cancel account pending for a week later and they’re still trying to charge me. I’ve had four attempts to charge my Apple Pay account when all I really wanted was to try the trial period and see what it was about like they lead you to believe is possible.

Impressive App that really works — I found the app from an article reviewing similar apps and it had the highest rank. I was eager to try it because I’m not a fan of the 12 step model, and I wanted to cut back rather than quit entirely. It uses evidence-based methods shown to work, and at no point has it been stigmatizing, patronizing, or annoying to work with. There is a heavy focus on understanding how alcohol affects the brain and body, very matter of fact and never exaggerating anything. It’s taken time to work but it does work. I feel so much more aware and in control, having chosen to cut back to a healthy level rather than quit entirely. I still love to drink but I’m able to keep limits now. I’m pretty blown away and this app has exceeded all expectations.

Nothing works at subscription page — Update: Customer service responded quickly, and they managed to fix the issue on the backend fast, as well. In addition, since I have been able to use it for a few days and I’m very impressed with the psychology implemented in the step-by-step lessons. Definitely re-rating to 5 stars. All the “redeem seven days” button does is bounce when I press it. When I press “restore purchase” to see if there’s some other way to trial it that way, absolutely nothing happens. Now I keep getting a pop-up that says “error performing request” The only other option is to go back, but all that does is lead me back to the questions. This app is a waste of my time and is very poorly built.

Recommend this app! — I think this is the first time I’ve ever actually written a review but I really love this app. It has truly helped me. Unlike other recovery apps I’ve used, it’s more than just a tracker and community hub. It is educational and it’s clear they’ve had professional psychologists / peer reviewed data to develop their content. Every morning I do I bite sized lesson, it’s just enough to motivate me but not enough to burn me out, which is perfect because I also have ADHD. You also have access to meetings around the clock that you don’t have to be on screen or even speak in which takes a lot of pressure off. For someone who has had a lot of slip ups, this has been the perfect daily addition to keep me engaged in my recovery.

Very Effective!! — I have struggled with alcohol use disorder for many years and have tried many different methods to recover. I’ve had success with different methods, such as AA, but I’ve relapsed in recent years and now I’m trying to get sober again. As anyone who has had serious AUD knows it is an extremely and serious disease. I’ve been using the reframe app for about a month combined with medication (naltrexone). I really feel like using Reframe daily is helping a lot. I have cut back my drinking significantly and I’m having alcohol free days regularly that I almost never had before using Reframe (and Naltrexone/Sinclair Method). I highly recommend using the app and the medication. It works and it’s easier to stick to than simple will power or 12 steps.

Reframe has helped me! — I absolutely love Reframe! I was ready to reduce my alcohol intake and tried Reframe as well as another service to help me on my journey. With my positive mindset, willpower, and Reframe, I’ve successfully reduced my alcohol intake within 10 days! I’ve also had two alcohol free days so far! Oh, did I mention I cancelled the other service?! Reframe not only allows me to track my drinks, but also provides educational materials, reflection exercises, and a tool kit with meditations, EFT, and a craving count down. The educational materials are what sold me! Knowing how alcohol affects my mind and body has helped me to stay the course. I have completed the activities daily! I have a year long subscription and look forward to my continual progress! Thank you, Reframe!

I love Reframe. It’s my daily morning ritual now. — I wanted to cut back my alcohol intake and my relationship with it. There are many negative reasons to make a change so I thought I’d try it, not knowing where Reframe would take me.  I am 45 days into doing the Daily take which only takes 3-10 minutes and I cannot believe the progress I have made and how fantastic I feel.  I have learned so much about how alcohol damages your body. This was a big wake up call.  I learned why I drank.  This was very enlightening. I learned different methods to coping with the reasons - including stress relievers, boundaries, reaction techniques, etc.  I have reduced my alcohol intake 93% over the last 6 weeks. My average is two drinks per week vs 15-28. And I am good with it. Thanks Reframe.

Highly recommend — Reframe has been a very useful tool for me. I’ve learned about how my brain is responding to alcohol and why but also learning a lot of other valuable life skills. It goes far beyond alcohol or substance abuse. This pays for itself within the first week so no buyer’s remorse here. I love that reframe can be utilized as little or as much as you want. I do my quick daily lessons and then check out the forum. I’ve done some chatting with other reframers on chats. You can attend online meetings. Also there are many other challenges that you can do. Breathing and tapping techniques for stressful times or cravings.  Love it. Starting this journey with a mindset that you’re hear for a reason and you want to make change really helps.

Reframe is amazing! — If I could give this app ten stars I would! I came to know about Reframe through encouragement by a healthcare provider who had found personal success with it. I put it off for several months until I was ready. Now that I’m here, I’m so very grateful! I was sober curious initially but I haven’t had a drink in nearly two months and it’s been an amazing journey. I couldn’t have done it without the Reframe education, support, and community forum. The daily check-ins keep me on track and motivated. I don’t know where life will lead me on this sober journey but I know I can lean on the Reframe community anytime I need it.  I should also add that anytime I’ve needed technical support, they’ve been incredibly responsive and helpful. So amazing! THANK YOU REFRAME!!

Edit: BUG SOLVED!, Yes and no — I originally wrote the review below last week, I was contacted and the problem was resolved with a few days. Thank you.   I do like this app…when it works. It is engaging and quick little bits to get on with your day. Last week or so, any time I try to go from a notification to the app I just get a blank white screen. After updating (and shutting down the app AND my phone) right before writing this review, even from the icon I got a blank white screen. I am a paying member & it is incredibly disappointing to not be able to access the app when I know I have free time, concentration and privacy (when I’ve specifically scheduled the notifications). Feels like I’ve been wasting my money.

Amazing!!! — This app really is all that.  It’s short and effective, very important for people who lead busy lives.   Some people can’t set aside time or have the means for therapy or to consult a professional about their drinking habits. For me  this was a great way to start my journey.  I am a bartender and am surrounded by alcohol consumption, my livelihood depends on it.  So it let hypocritical to not drink.  However drinking is different from person to person and it’s up to the individual to forms healthy relationship with it or not at all.  Anyway, this app is great, I’ve been on it for four months and I have seen such drastic changes in my every day behaviors and work. Recommend highly for sober curious and those who want to start the journey to sobriety.

Great app - highly recommend if you want to explore your relationship with alcohol — I would not have considered myself a problematic drinker or alcoholic, but I was concerned with the frequency I was having wine in the evenings. This app is full of science-based tools to reduce or stop drinking. I love the daily tasks because they are interesting and take so little time. I also like the craving tools when one hits. I would definitely recommend this app for people who are questioning their relationship with alcohol and want to cut back. I’ve reduced my intake since starting and I truly believe I’ll get down to my target number of drinks in the next month or so. It’s not easy to stop a bad habit, but as you’ll be reminded in this app, you can do hard things.

Very Helpful Tool — I have been using Reframe for about 3 months and it has really helped me hold myself accountable. I’m on day 50 of a 60 day detox/reset, which is the longest I’ve gone without drinking in my adult life (I’m 35!). Each day, I open the app and click “did not drink today” and I get my little gold star (which is actually a hot mug icon). For me, the psychology of this is so simple but effective. Also, reading about the effects of alcohol on the body from a scientific perspective has been helpful in changing my long term relationship with alcohol. I know that I will continue to enjoy a glass of wine (because I love the taste, culture and history of wine!) here and there but I never want alcohol to take more than it gives ever again!

So supportive! — I joined Reframe a couple of months ago, to learn more about the effects of alcohol use, and to cut back a little more myself. This app has a daily set of things to complete: a guided meditation, a short reading, an encouragement… and more. There is a forum where members can support each other, learn from each other, and share about their journeys with their goals or cutting back or going completely alcohol free. The app also has zoom calls you can join— like the “sober Saturdays” late afternoon call, in addition to other kinds of daily calls. They help you track how much you drink (or if you drink) on a daily basis. I have asked them to have a hashtag for ACOAs (Adult Children of Alcoholics), for the forum. I hope they will!

Love this app and the Reframe Community! — This app is truly a life saver. It has given me  support on my journey to reframe my alcohol use and addiction! And it has so many cool Features. Today I found yet another one which prompted me to do this review. I was writing a journal entry for a daily reading and found a button that you can hit to help guide your journal entry with AI!!! It is spot on. If you’re stuck and having a difficult time with journal entries, this app will help. I just downloaded the Reframe Stress app and am looking forward to using that as well.   Such a great investment for anyone wishing to improve their relationship to alcohol or quit alcohol for good! there is so much more that the app makes us think about on our self improvement journeys.

Life changing tool for cutting back or quitting drinking — I can't express enough how Reframe has transformed my life. I stumbled upon Reframe, and it has been a game-changer.  The app's user-friendly interface makes tracking my progress and setting goals a breeze. It provides valuable insights into my drinking patterns, helping me understand my triggers and vulnerabilities better. The daily reminders and motivational messages have been a crucial source of support on tough days.  What truly sets Reframe apart is its community feature. I've connected with others on the same journey, sharing stories, strategies, and encouragement. It's like having a personal support system in my pocket 24/7.  Since I started using Reframe, I've successfully cut back on my alcohol consumption, and my overall well-being has improved significantly. I owe a huge debt of gratitude to this app for helping me regain control over my life.  If you're looking for a reliable, effective, and supportive tool to cut back or quit drinking, I wholeheartedly recommend Reframe. It's been a lifeline for me, and I believe it can be for you too. Give it a try, and you won't be disappointed

Stick with it! — Reframe has changed my life and has helped me make it far better on my sobriety journey! Other well known programs don’t work for me, but Reframe made all the difference in meeting my needs. Can’t say enough good things about it. It’s really the only thing that has helped me. Try it, take in the daily readings and progress percentages to stay motivated. My only wish is that the daily percentages continue throughout my use of the app. At some point (not sure when) it stops indicating what percentage of your day you’ve been sober. I found myself looking at that percentage and feeling super accomplished when I would see how much of my day I’ve made it through without drinking.  All that aside, I love this app!

It really works, give it a chance — I started Reframe January 2024 and did it on and off throughout the year but did not do it every day after dry January. January 1, 2025 I decided to commit to every day this time I was more engaged in groups and other activities. It works! I went from drinking 7 to 12 drinks per week down to one drink a week and most weeks-zero drinks! if you are looking to cut back or change your relationship with drinking, I highly recommend this app! The more you participate, you are rewarded with coins. You can then use these coins for free months using the app, free merchandise, and one on one coaching sessions. The online groups are very inviting and non-judgmental. give yourself a gift and get this app 💛

I feel beautiful! — Since I started Reframe 732 days ago for #cutback, I look in the mirror and love who I’m becoming. My goal was to cutback so to be the best I can be, true to myself and feel good each day to nurture my creativity, music, quilting, knitting, gardening, etc. I also wanted to be fully present and healthy for my husband and children. Reframe is not just about cutting back or quitting drinking but it’s also about the whole body. It’s a holistic approach to becoming the best person you can be. The daily readings, monthly challenges and courses offered are all very helpful. Reframe’s customer service is stellar! They respond quickly to an App glitch and are always very helpful. Thank you Reframe team, forum friends and my monthly challenge teammates!

Great updates! — I took a break from this app for a while because it was losing its effectiveness (and I backslid big time due to lots of turmoil in my personal life). I tried out a different one when I realized I let my drinking get out of control again. I used a free trial of Sunnyside for a bit and liked some of the features but missed the insights on mental and physical health. So I came back to Reframe (mostly because I realized my subscription was still active). I was pleasantly surprised to find that the features I liked about the other app had been added to Reframe!! Examples: text reminders instead of just push notifications; daily goals for how many drinks you'll have instead of just a weekly goal.

This app is amazing!! — I downloaded this app to help me track my alcohol intake. I started learning so much from the daily tasks about the brain and alcohol and overall health…I knew I wanted to quit drinking! So I signed up for the 30 day challenge, then dry July! And then knocked out the 1000 hours sober challenge and am almost done with the Brutal Recovery 90 challenge. Each day the lessons build on the previous day. I have learned meditation and visualization techniques and my toolbox is full of ways to live a healthy happy life without alcohol!!!! If you are interested in living a dry life, this is the app for you!! Use it to its fullest! Do the tracking, write the journal prompts, watch the video links, go the meditations!! You will be so happy you did!

This app is really helping me… — I downloaded Reframe on NYE thinking just like I normally do that this would just be a free trial and what would it accomplish?  Two weeks in and I have reduced my consumption by more than half and this app is really easy to follow.  They break down the science into bite size easy to understand segments I can read/ listen to in 1-3 minutes and really understand how alcohol is effecting me. I find myself drinking less and deciding to do other things. I’ve slept way better, haven’t been hung over in two weeks and my stomach is also feeling better.  I am more focused at work and I am not irritated at the littlest things. I definitely recommend and have recommended to several friends.

I SLIPPED AND THEN GOT UP — Reframe is medical science, redesigned in terms that non-scientists can understand.  I highly recommend Reframe for those of us who desire to refocus the role alcohol has in our lives and desire to regain control of our alcohol use.  In just three weeks Reframe has helped me immensely.  Moreover, Reframe is packaged in such a way that I look forward to my Reframe daily lessons.  These lessons are neither time consuming nor burdensome.    I also recommend Reframe for those who wish to build their skill set as they desire to help and understand a loved one who has or is slipping song their path of alcohol consumption and/or recovery.    Simply stated, in an educational and pleasant manner Reframe has motivated me to drink less and restored my sense of self control.

Just stick with it. — I probably futzed around on the app here and there for quite a while, but at the point where I really committed to making some changes to my drinking, it has been a very useful tool to help me stay on track. It never felt overwhelming, just a little bit each day, and the tools and content are really valuable (and, as a healthcare provider, I can verify that they’re clinically sound).  ETA: I’ve now been alcohol-free for 210 days, and I know that Reframe has been a key element of this. I’ve been pleasantly surprised by the sheer number of resources, challenges, and courses available, and the cost is extremely reasonable, less per month than I would have paid for a single bottle of wine.

Love it — I really, really love this app. It’s the only thing that has actually worked for me so far. I love seeing my stats, the readings are poignant, realistic, and helpful. I like logging my drinks one by one as opposed to other apps that just ask whether you drank or not, yes or no, no matter whether it was one drink or ten. I appreciate that this app caters to people who only wish to cut down, not just quit completely. And for a long time I was searching for an app that tells me how my body is healing itself day by day after I cut down and this app does that. Also, the meditations are fantastic and effective. Really soothing voice-overs. ***The only thing I wish this app included is the ability to save or “star” my favorite readings and meditations and things like that. Please please please!

Life changing! — I was skeptical that an app could help me cutback on my alcohol consumption but within 2 months of using it my life has changed in so many positive ways.   The tools and support this app provides helps me to understand why I’ve had a hard time limiting my alcohol consumption. I’ve learned the neuroscience and biological effects of consuming alcohol in an easy and non- threatening manner. I’m learning how to handle my relationships and set boundaries with my friends and family that drink to excess.   If you are examining your relationship with alcohol, I highly recommend you give the free month a try. I knew within a month that this was the tool to help me change my life in the most positive way!

Excellent customer support — Joined this on a trial. Really impressed with the concept— seems to be a very positive way to understand and take control of drinking. Mostly though, I’m impressed with the customer support. I had an issue and reached out to the Reframe team. They instantly resolved my problem. Furthermore, subsequent communication with the team was personable, prompt, and understanding. With large, successful apps like this, my expectation is that I’m treated like a paying customer and no more. Well, this is not the case with reframe. They went above and beyond to provide me with an exceptional experience— so much so that I had to write this. My sincere at appreciation to this team. 10/10 would recommend.

Life changing App! — The app is the best I’ve ever seen! As somebody who’s cutting back from horrible alcoholism, I’ve been able to reduce my intake by over 50%. This app is quite unique and interactive, you will keep track of your drinks, find helpful reading material and jot down your goals for every single day. Every morning you will have 10 minutes of reading and simple written guided journal writing that will set the pace, mindset and rhythm of your day. There are plenty of zoom sessions you can join and a number of groups you can participate in! Just follow every single recommendation and don’t get lazy with the reading and journaling. Absolutely fantastic app, highly recommended and thank you Reframe!!

I really love this app — I searched for an alcohol free tracking app to help me cut back. Reframe stuck out to me because it wasn’t about cutting alcohol out cold turkey, but rather a helpful and informative guide to cutting back your intake. I have never really done a dry month before. This app has helped me SO much in staying sober!! I love the daily tasks, I actually look forward to reading all the mini articles discussing how alcohol impacts the brain, the body, your moods, appearance, etc. and it even gives you prompts to jot down your thoughts/experience so far. The information they share on the app is very insightful and gentle, it doesn’t make you feel crappy about yourself or decisions. I highly recommend reframe!! ❤️

No app exists like this — I have yet to find an app that has changed my approach on life and drinking in general. I was in a pretty bad place: divorce, depressed, losing my job, you name it, it has happened. Not lying and I do not put this lightly to say that Reframe has absolutely changed my life. I get excited for the daily tasks and knowledge to learn more and more about the effects of alcohol. If you can change your approach, this changes your mindset which in turn, changes your life. This app the is the gateway to living a sober lifestyle. Huge shoutout to the developers. I promise you will find NOTHING out there like this. No matter what place you are in physically, emotionally, and spiritually, give this a try. You will be rewarded!

Highly recommend! — I’m now 60 days on my journey using the Reframe to a better relationship with alcohol. I’ve been looking for a number of years for a support that worked for me and in Reframe I’ve found it. Loads of information presented in such a way that it’s manageable and not intimidating.  There are tools galore, support at many levels and all presented in easy friendly manner.  At 80 years of age I chose to reduce rather than eliminate alcohol and, remarkably, I’m doing it!! Without even being totally aware of it or so it seems.  If you’re struggling like I had been doing, give Reframe a try…..and remember, in a saying attributed to Confucius, “it does not matter how slowly you go, so long as you do not stop”.

Awesome App! — I download this because my boyfriend and I kept fighting about little things and I realized that I, of course, may be part of the problem… Well, he is gone but I’m still using the app and loving it! Really made me realize that he pushed shots on me when we were going out and wasn’t capable of just having a drink or two… Meanwhile I was capable of having a drink or two, but when you do that at lunch with clients, and then you do it happy hour with friends, then you do it at dinner w your S/O, it adds up and probably was making me more edgy and reactive. Wholeheartedly recommend this app even if you aren’t looking to quit drinking and just want to have a better awareness of your imbibing.

Better than the top inpatient rehabs in the U.S. — It’s no secrete to my friends, co-workers and family that I’ve struggled with alcohol use disorder. I’ve gone to one of the top rehabs in the United States and still struggled….. until reframe. This is more than an APP it’s really a life changing tool that is for everyone looking to change their relationship with alcohol. Even those just looking to cut back but not completely remove it. I started reframe with the intention of just cutting back but after one week the app had me realizing so much. I decided to change the plan I was on to eliminating alcohol! I am still going strong thanks to reframe! The education, tools and community is more than I’ve found anywhere else!!!

Great app that keeps good habits going — Yes, there’s no energy wasted, honestly! There’s no having to get bent out of shape, it’s just is a doing it with Joy. Wake up in the morning, get my vitamins, and that includes my Reframe. It helps with getting day going, and staying on the straighten arrow. It’s also a community. There’s so many amazing stories, representing the people .  It’s well worth it to invest into yourself, and it also helps other people because, hey, you never know, your life story can be an amazing inspiration to another persons. Life story. Hope that makes sense. Refreeze map is great. I was recommended it by another fellow Reframe app person, so there’s no judgment. Press on a click it and invest into yourself. Excelsior !  Joe F

Took my money — The concept and approach are probably great, but I decided I’m not interested in this app. I cancelled my subscription several days before my trial ended and they proceeded to offer me a ton of money off, which is super nice! However, I was still not interested and declined, and continued to cancel my membership. I was then charged the yearly $120 fee, despite cancelling several days earlier. I emailed customer service to correct this and NEVER heard back. In my opinion, this is not only unprofessional but also theft. I canceled my subscription within the acceptable amount of time, was still charged, tried to be cordial and give them the benefit of the doubt, and the error was not corrected. I am extremely unimpressed regarding how they do their business. This review is not meant to reflect how they assist with alcohol education/consumption, I’m just upset as a consumer that I wasted my money and was not treated professionally.

Best app for your overall heath. — This app is amazing, more then I could have ever imagined when I signed up. It’s main focus is helping you maneuver and alcohol free lifestyle with all its ups and downs, but you also have options to cut back. This app is a community, filled with supportive people with the same goal in mind… to be their best selves. Not only do you have other Reframes you also have the support of the incredible coaches that are active daily on the app. They interact with you and also hold space for you to feel welcome and heard. There’s a little bit of everything in this gem. Workshops, book clubs, but most importantly a whole lot of learning.  Check it out, this app does not disappoint.

Best app to cut back or quit drinking — In 398 days, I'm close to leaving alcohol in the rear view mirror.  I joined Reframe a year ago with the intention of cutting back. I was concerned about my 1 to 2 glass wine/day habit. Since cutting back, I really don't like to drink any longer. I'm participating in Dry January for the second time and it's been a breeze. Im going for another 30 days after this and may just quit altogether. This app has daily lessons, anonymous group meetings, a great forum where you can share your struggles and successes. This app helps you inderstand that alcohol, in any quantity, is poison. There is no pressure to make you quit. You simply learn by doing the work, and hopefully come out on the other side enlightened.

Changed my life — I’m not being dramatic even a little when I say my entire life has changed for the better since embarking on this Reframe journey. This app teaches you so much! Not just about alcohol and it’s effects on your body and mind but also about how to grow as a person and how to be a better version of yourself. I learn something new each day on this app and I’m eternally grateful for everything this app has given me. Without the daily check-ins and support system that this app offers, I really don’t know where I would be today. I’ve been sober for several months now and I attribute that almost entirely to this app. Thank you, Reframe, for changing my life!

My thoughts and gratitude towards refrain — Years ago it seem fairly easy for me to drink alcohol and leave it for a while as time passed on it become more and more difficult for me to leave it. I was drinking every day. I found this app and it has certainly help me a lot. My daily readings are very important to me. I have learned, whole alcohol is metabolized how it has damaged my body and haul my body will recover from the years of abuse when I get a craving I begin to think about my daily readings and whole alcohol has affected me and I have to say when I think back on my daily readings, it is much easier for me not to drink. I thank you for this app and I thank you all for your hard work.

Unused 1:1 Coaching Sessions DO NOT CARRYOVER FROM MONTH TO MONTH — Happy to report the Reframe Team responded quickly to my concerns and the issues have been resolved.  The Reframe Program has improved my life immensely and improved my relationship with alcohol.  My Reframe Coach Nikita is the most skilled Counselor I’ve ever worked with.  🙌Truly Grateful For th Reframe Program  I am having a difficult time giving Reframe a Rating of 1 STAR. But I have had a Monthly Coaching Pass Membership for a long time and I just discovered that my: UNUSED COACHING SESSIONS DO NOT CARRY OVER FROM MONTH TO MONTH AND DO NOT ACCUMULATE FOR FUTURE USE. Due to many health issues and immediate Death in th Family, I have not been consistent in my focus on the Reframe Program. Most of my 1:1 Coaching Sessions have not been used. BUT, I HAVE BEEN CHARGED $249 EVERY MONTH. I have searched everywhere on the Reframe APP information and I cannot find anything that explains 1:1 COACHING SESSIONS DO NOT CARRYOVER FROM MONTH TO MONTH.
