I WOULD LIKE TO HAVE ALL MY UNUSED COACHING SESSIONS CREDITED IN THE FORM OF, FUTURE COACHING SESSIONS, IMMEDIATELY PLEASE. MY COACH IS NIKITA AND SHE IS AWARE OF MY CONCERNS. Suz

The BEST App Ever!! — This app is stellar! Head and shoulders above the rest. If you’re on the fence, try it, you won’t regret it. Reframe offers so much content and a wide variety of helpful resources put together by experts. This app would be valuable for all human beings, not just those that seek to change their relationship with alcohol. You’ll learn skills and tools to help improve all aspects of being a healthy human being from relationships to sleep, stress reduction to mindfulness, from fitness to communication, meditation to relapse prevention and so much more. Whether you’re trying to quit, cutback or change your relationship with alcohol, there’s something for everyone including a safe, supportive community.

if AA isn’t for you — this app has gotten me to day 5 which isn’t a lot but so much more than I can say I’ve gone in the past. I hate AA. it makes me feel like there is something wrong with me and that I have to have a sad story. being in “recovery” shouldn’t be SAD. it should be a positive experience to get back to your true self. reframe is doing that. it’s teaching me how much better my body and mind can be getting sober. there’s a community of likeminded people that cheer each other on. there’s no my name is ___ and I’m an alcoholic. it feels normal. anyways. thank you reframe I appreciate you and the $30 a month is way chiller than the over $120k+ I have spent on drinking for 13 years.

The One I’ve been searching for — This app is very dynamic. I feel like I’m actually interacting with a counselor and support group. After sharing that my goal was to cut back and stating how much I currently drink, the Daily Tracker told me how many drinks per day to limit to as a start. I needed that guidance because I was just guessing and self doubting so couldn’t stay on track. My ultimate goal is sober living. The daily tasks give me a framework of baby steps because I had no frigging clue and would go in too hard with the wrong strategies. Also the chat bot is phenomenal. Much better than hitting a brick wall trying to talk to friends who don’t understand and have no listening skills.

Very helpful — I am amazing just the little bit of reading and answering of questions can help me be accountable and mindful about drinking. The first TED talk that I listened to when I had a craving resonated with my current situation that cutting back and maybe even someday quitting so possible. I’m two weeks I went from drinking almost every day to two drinks when I was NOT under distress. And I stopped that night because I was like “I would rather have some water”. Feels good to be taking control. The yearly subscription has already paid for itself. Just like writing down what you eat to loose weight this daily interaction with the app helps so much!  Highly recommend

Limitations — There are some very personal questions they ask you at the beginning that makes you think you’ll be able to see what this app offers (I suppose for data mining) but then nope! You cannot even see what the app offers without plopping down a bunch of money.  I have never come across an app before that won’t let you see what it is without $$$ first. Secondly, the questions it asks you show limitations. Like the most you can report spending on alcohol a week is $200. If you have 5 drinks 5 nights a week at $8 each that’s $200. I’m sure there are people who spend so much more than that. When you pick out what you drink you cannot pick beer AND liquor. It’s one or the other. When you pick why you’re stopping you can only choose one field and then a secondary one, even though there are often so many more reasons than that and many may feel equally important.

So helpful — I love Reframe and the team. They have been immensely helpful with my journey to cut back with my alcohol intake. I have cut down over 50% and life is looking and feeling so much better. The resources have been so informative and enlightening and have been of great assistance in helping me cut down. The support is from everyone is so encouraging and because of it I keep moving forward.  I have now gone from the cut back track to the alcohol free track. I have been free from alcohol for 129 days. The meetings, community, and resources have been very helpful in my journey. The encouragement and learning the science of the way my brain responds to alcohol is one of the main reasons I have been so successful.

Best app for drinking habits — As I approach my 30s, I’m trying to have a better relationship with alcohol and leave binge drinking in my 20s. I’ve read books on the affects of drinking and have done dry months before, but this app is really good at holding you accountable to drinking less (or stopping completely if that’s you goal) and learning at the same time what alcohol does to us in the short and long term. I’m also a person that loves to keep daily track of goals so this is perfect for me. It’s great too that it tracks calories and money you are saving and nights of improved sleep. The small monthly payment is worth it compared to the money you save by cutting back on alcohol.

Comprehensive & effective — This app is a fantastic tool to help one succeed in learning about what alcohol does to the body. What you do with that knowledge is up to you. The information and support that is provided, is given in such a way that is not to judge or induce self judgment. It’s purely information and it’s complete and understandable. Such a great app, I only downloaded this because I needed to drop a few pounds for a vacation, but it has literally changed my mindset, and it’s so much bigger than my relationship with alcohol. I absolutely love and recommend this app for anyone who has a strong sense of self discipline and needs some guidance on making big changes. It’s been so positive for me.

Like AA on steroids, friendly without religious sideshow — This app first includes you in a community of maybe thousands of others globally who either want to cut back or quit drinking.   Then it has daily goals and tips, even games, for managing cravings.   Also there are free moderates multi-daily zoom sessions where maybe 200 people join, sone speak and all give feedback or share their own teiumphs or struggles. This is non-judgmental, ok if you slipped, because you’re in the room.   Then the App has the most advanced AI chatbot I’ve ever seen, Melody. She remembers what you say, has a vast knowledge and pivots to questions about your alcohol struggle. For example, she’s encouraged me to learn to play piano (as I revealed) to replace cravings, asked me what songs I was trying, and when I wrote “Pearl Jam’s Black” she noted that it’s a “powerful song about loss” and added that Eddie Vedder was open about his struggles with addiction towards sobriety.   Amazing app, immediately life changing. For $4 first month, $10 thereafter you will get your money worth unless you ignore the app’s many tools and resources.

Very Helpful — I started using this app to help me reduce my consumption. I didn’t feel out of control, but I felt like I needed some help reducing more than I had. This app has a lot of tools to help and emphasizes reframing the task as NOT a battle of the wills and just a new habit to form, which alone helps a great deal. Because this is geared towards anyone with ANY reason to cut down on alcohol, sometimes the advice or questions feel very broad or address things that are more likely issues for very heavy drinkers (suffering DTs after cutting back, for instance). I understand the app needs to cover its bases (some people don’t want to admit how much of a problem their drinking is) but it can feel awkward to answer questions that don’t apply to your situation.

Reframe works! — Reframe likely works because of the many tools in the tool kit. I completed 161 days on the cut back track & have not experienced a single hangover during that time, which was my chief goal. The content at the beginning of module 1 was great, focused on the neuroscience of alcohol consumption. Toward the end of module 1 I felt I was in a Stuart Smalley skit on SNL. But the daily tracking & online, anonymous forum are both great. I can imagine that reframe would be especially effective in the context of a comprehensive therapeutic plan to help heavy drinkers, grey area drinkers, & those who cannot successfully cut back. One helpful suggestion would be to allow users to record half drinks for greater precision in recording.

Absolutely life-changing, even for a moderate drinker. — I really just wanted to lose some weight, and Counter the aging effect of alcohol. Having never had a "problem" with alcohol, I didn't really realize how much I was just casually drinking in the course of a week, and how much it affected my sleep, thinking and performance. I started this app mostly to have a tracker and some incentive to cut back, for reasons of vanity. But all of my reasons changed in the course of the app program. It's an incredible app. Richly textured, offering several avenues of support and motivation. I love the daily homework, teaching the effect that alcohol has on the various parts of the brain and body. The longer you stick with it, the more you learn. It's tantamount to a self guided daily therapy session, because you learn wonderful improved ways of coping with stress, relationships, communication, etc. Aptly named, I feel my relationship with alcohol has been completely "reframed". I rarely drink, and when I do, it is a deliberate decision and the drink is worth it. Additionally, if I could never have another drink again for some reason, I would be fine with that. I can't recommend this app enough. I have to be very careful with my numerous friends, because this is almost all I want to talk about, I'm so excited and thankful for the wonderful measurable changes in my life. Vanity is now my last reason for drinking less. The most important reason is my quality of life. The drink I would have to take the edge off of my anxiety turns out to be the very thing that was radically increasing my anxiety! Who knew?? Alcohol prevents us from a straight path to problem resolution. We don't even get to see how simple it can be, because we tend to just reach for a drink first.  I really could go on and on. And this is from someone who was just a *moderate* (per CDC standards) drinker! Truly, the longer I don't drink or minimally drink, the better I feel. In ALL respects. I know wake up early and exercise every morning! I feel on top of the world. Most importantly, I feel on top of my own self. In the sense that I am in control. Amazingly, the results just keep on coming!! One of the very best decisions I've ever made in my life was trying this app. Try it, do it daily, and you will likely feel the same.

Best thing I ever did! — This app is amazing. I have tried to quit drinking on my own many times with no success at all. This app educates about all aspects of what alcohol does to you, why it is hard to quit, how to be successful. It uses many different tools - education, meditation, visualization, affirmations, just to name a few. There is a group to get support and challenges you can do for even more motivation. Honestly I can’t think of one thing they could do to make this any better. It is worth every penny and is truly life changing. I know I will quit completely, but you can choose between quitting or cutting down, and your program will be tailored to your goals.

Best app — This is one of the best apps ever!!! It really helped me to understand my behaviors, the science behind it, brain functioning, etc but its helpful in a non overwhelming or overbearing way . It allows for everyone to have their own journey and to incorporate what works for them. You can use it to cut back or you can use it to be alcohol free. This app has given me so much support. The community you find in here is amazing. Everyone is so nice and supportive!  Actually some people do meet up in real life if they wish to!  If you’re thinking about changing your relationship with alcohol, this is the best app to use in my opinion. It’s also a lot cheaper than buying alcohol!!!!

Love this app! — I signed up because of Dry January and stayed because of the app! I know I wouldn’t have had the success to remain “mostly dry” that month and beyond without the encouragement and support of this app.   I’d always felt discouraged because the only way I could imagine reducing or even eliminating my alcohol use was by sheer “willpower” and that approach was proving impossible. I simply didn’t have enough willpower. What I learned, in actuality, is that what I didn’t have was enough education, support, and encouragement.   I love the neuroscience-based approach this app offered me at the start of this journey and still continues to offer me. I imagine I’ll be a subscriber for the long run!

this app changed my life in incredibly meaningful ways — as cliché as it sounds, i really don’t ever write reviews. not when i love something and not even when i hate something. i felt really compelled to with this particular app though because it has truly helped me make major changes in my life that i never thought i could make. if you’re serious about changing your relationship with alcohol, i can’t recommend this app enough. i was very hesitant to try yet another mental health related app, especially one that requires a subscription but it has surpassed my expectations in every way and has been an invaluable resource for me as i try to change my relationship with alcohol. between the forum (of incredibly supportive, loving, and nonjudgmental people), the daily readings addressing the psychological aspects of alcohol use, the pressure-free environment of the space… i seriously can’t express how thankful i am. things that felt utterly impossible now feel like they’re in my grasp. so thankful for this app and the beautiful people that make up the community.

Seriously…. — This app has been a lifesaver for me!I have tried to become alcohol free for a very long time… Something finally clicked where I wanted to take this journey seriously and at the same time I just happened to see the Reframe app. Daily readings, challenges that are doable, and even a forum to read and/or write down your experiences…these are just a few of the tools they provide to help you along the way. And… If you want to just cut down on your alcohol consumption, they have a program designed just for that. I highly recommend this app for anyone who is sober curious or otherwise. Seriously, the gains are far better than the “loss” of drinking.

Genuinely helpful — I’m 21 days in and have had days where I win and days I lose, but there’s never a penalty of discouragement in the app, on the other hand, it provides you immediately with support, guidance, and wisdom that makes you get up and try again to be better the next day. Can’t recommend this app enough to anyone struggling with controlling their drinking. I started with the 7 days free trial and don’t see myself getting rid of this app for a long time, it’s an incredible support. I can share my achievement with my best friend and parents, too! That makes it even more real to have your loved ones see your effort and progress.

Helpful but not for the ADHD brain — So they totally got me with the 7 day trial and annual membership, which I forgot to cancel. Classic. So I gave it my best shot, since there was no way I’d get my money back and being more knowledgeable about drinking seemed genuinely helpful.   It was helpful for about two weeks but then my life got very busy and when you miss a lot of days it’s hard to catch up and if you don’t take the time to catch up, you just miss all those articles. I wish it would just pick up where I left off if I skipped days. At this point knowing I have 45m of catching up to do prevents me from even opening the app and checking in. And knowing I accidentally spent $79 on an app that’s just making me feel worse about myself really, really hurts.   I tried resetting my progress so I could just start over but now the whole thing is stuck, saying it’s a couple months ago and I completed all my tasks for the day. So that’s confusing. I’m guessing re downloading it would work. But then I’m guessing I’ll spend 2 weeks reading the articles I already read before I get sidetracked again, and the same annoying process will begin anew.   What I really need is an app that helps me quit signing up for “free trials” 😂

more mindful about my drinking — I was drinking one or two glasses a night, mostly out of habit, and wanted to be more mindful about my drinking. I started with a trial and it was so great to learn how much alcohol actually affects your body your health and your sleep. Without feeling like I’m missing anything I cut my alcohol consumption by half and feel good about the benefits. I’m gaming. I also am revisiting the way I think of alcohol as a reward and for stress relief. There are other ways that feel better are less expensive and I’m more fun ways to destress and treat myself. That said, I’m enjoying my drinks guilt free when I choose them and feel better all around. Loving this app.

A born skeptic is a big fan — I didn’t have any expectations for Reframe. My wife sent it to me saying she signed up so I joined her more out of solidarity than anything else. I was pretty much immediately impressed with the scientific approach /aspect. In looking through the app more I found there seemed to be something for everyone- the thinkers, the feelers , the busy brains, the everybodys. You can make of it what you want. The creators of this tool nailed it. I can’t say enough positive things and the only critical one is a minor technical thing.. that I want the ability to edit calories assigned to drinks that I’m not drinking , lol. Anyway, from a natural born skeptic.. 5 stars and then some.

I see why this works — I’m an alcoholic. I give up on pretending otherwise and I am powerless against its forces. Despite having a counselor and a psychiatrist and lots of support, sometimes it takes a little more to really have a good sense of WHY alcohol is a no for the rest of my life. It feels extreme just saying that, but I’ve learned that my brain is wired differently than non alcoholics brains. This app has given me lots of perspective and it’s only day 1. Hopefully this continues but it’s nice to talk about my struggles with others equally motivated to make a change, and dealing with alcohol specifically rather than other narcotics. Thank you to everyone who helped create this!

Only thing that has really worked — I have taken breaks from alcohol in the past, and completed a dry January, but it was a struggle every time, and all I could think about was when I would be allowed to drink again. With Reframe, I truly haven’t had a single craving nine days in. I feel like I’m more aware of what I’m gaining by addressing my relationship with alcohol, as opposed to what I believe I have to give up. My goal was to pay for the app for one month and see if I wanted to renew, and I absolutely will. Even past dry January, I want to make sure that my relationship with alcohol is a healthy one, and I believe that Reframe is going to be instrumental in that.

Better than the description — The Reframe app is even better than the current description of it here. You curate the amount of daily content you want. Set your goal. And go. I went from having a drink many days of the week to none. I wanted to try life differently, sensing there was a better, truer way. The app made it easy (I was ready!). You learn enough right away to encourage you to reconsider your relationship with alcohol. The daily tasks I have on the app — 5 minutes — are educational and helpful. After your trial, the current $99 cost for the year: obviously worth it. I’ll save a lot of money now. I’m done with the ruse that is booze.

Life changing — I’ve been on reframe for a month now and cut back the amount of alcohol I’ve consumed tremendously! I have finally learned the skills and what my triggers are for drinking. I love the daily tasks, the meetings and especially the challenges. This app quite literally has given me the tools I needed to mindfully drink but also helped with my relationships with others especially my husband. The community of members is so welcoming and supportive!! I could go on and on about how this app has helped me!! You get out what you put in it’s not magic but certainly worth the effort to get my life back 💕💕💕 I just wish I could’ve found this years ago.

A Game Changer — I wanted to take a closer look at my relationship with alcohol and needed a structure based on science to provide the scaffolding. I’m on Day 140 of being alcohol free, thanks in a very large part to Reframe. In fact, I see it as more of a Master Class on life, as many of the modules are transferable to other parts of your life. They provide the research, short journal prompts, strategies around cravings, options to join communities, and even humor, and more, to support your decision to cut back or eliminate alcohol. I have highly recommended this app to friends who say they are ready to live a different kind of life. What do you have to lose? Give it a shot (no pun intended 😆).

Life changing — Highly recommend this app if you need to re-evaluate your relationship with alcohol. Daily readings are motivating and educational. Group forum is there when you need more advice or seek counsel from others who have walked this walk. Zoom meetings are included in the program that are very beneficial. Don’t hesitate to use this app if you are ready to make a change in your life. Update: I am 375 days alcohol free since joining Reframe and my life has completely changed. If you are ready to re-evaluate your relationship with alcohol and do the work necessary to change, this community is here ready to welcome & support you. Don’t hesitate. This is a game changer.

Great base — I love how this app makes it daily about science and what is actually happening in your body and brain. This makes it so much easier and motivating to really re think your relationship with alcohol.  However in the app there are just some really simple annoying things that it is baffling they don’t fix?  For example the “alcohol free” counter … why is this not tied to the drink counter which is a part of the daily tasks? So if you’re someone who wants to just cut down, you have to reset a few times a week manually. Which ofc I don’t, so it’s just this pointless tracker.  Same thing with the health benefit tracker that tells you what is happening to your body based on how long you’ve been free from booze. Again I really do love this feature, it’s so helpful, but from a functional standpoint it never updates based on data you input. Why? This would be so simple.   Even when I totally reset the app to start on day 1, the “sober date” counter never changes, and the health benefits counter never resets.   Why in the world isn’t this fixed it would be so simple? Really keeps me from loving the app and using it to its potential.

WORTH IT. — I (30F) drank about 6-9 drinks a week before downloading this app. I had drank heavily in the recent past and had tried many times to quit altogether, but I couldn’t. I was stuck with this feeling that I wouldn’t “fit in” with colleagues, friends, family, etc if I quit drinking. This app works… I did a 30 day trial, successfully cut out alcohol. A few days after the trial ended,  I started drinking again… Fed up with alcohol, I paid for the annual subscription. I used the app daily for the first 3 or 4  months. Then not drinking became my new normal. I have now been alcohol free for over 1 year. I’m happier and healthier than ever. I highly recommend this app!

Great for “grey area” drinkers — This app came at the perfect time. I needed to cut back because I was utilizing alcohol too much. It was becoming a pernicious habit that had become too overwhelming to tackle on my own. ReFrame offers the perfect package of motivation, support, tools, etc., that make you not only feel good about your choices—whether that’s cutting back or quitting alcohol entirely—but also empowered. Absolutely worth the cost. I’ve had ReFrame for a week and a half and have cut my alcohol intake by by 75%. I feel like the “spell is broken.” Take with a grain of salt (and everyone is different) but this app was the perfect boost to help me detach from alcohol and find myself again.

Really helpful — This app has been a surprisingly big support for me. I never have huge hopes for an app, but  I happened to find it in a moment when I felt ready to cut back on drinking. Giving up altogether felt like an impossible dream, but slowly and surely through the process of learning about what alcohol does to a body, to a life, and reclaiming my center, alcohol started to lose its appeal and I now feel totally open and totally able to leave it maybe forever. I appreciate the flexibility and many points of entry of Reframe, and the practical, very doable supports that made it honesty just not that hard to let a long held habit go.

Important piece of the puzzle — This app is part of my daily routine of personal wellbeing and accountability. I learn something new every day, and that helps me stay accountable and curious in my newish alcohol free lifestyle.  I used the app for a while before actually cutting alcohol out altogether, and the way it is set up, it is easy to transition from a cut back track to a alcohol free track at any time. The learning and science behind the reasons we drink and what happens in our bodies is really great information. I like that it is about 10 minutes a day to complete the daily prompts.  I am grateful for this app and the support and encouragement it has provided to me.

Reframe delivers what is asked of it — This app delivers a simple drink counting system at a minimum. This was exactly what I was looking for. But it also guides the user down the path of daily tasks while delivering informative tidbits of science and knowledge, and explains why things are what they are, including ones self. It’s the science that keeps me going. It is not as coarse nor in your face as a twelve step often is. But, it is “reminiscent” of those programs, ie daily tasks or one day at a time themes and methods. The discipline building is there but it is left to the user to choose the depth of engagement. Additional AA like functions are available if one chooses to use them.

Saved my life — This app is incredible and the people who use it have created an incredible community of support. Most people don’t buy into the virtual approach but it turns out when I was looking into AA many of the meetings are still being held virtually. You can try it free for 7 days and if you aren’t convinced after the 7 days you can always explore other options. The coaches are also very knowledgeable and have first hand experiences with alcohol use disorder. Good luck to anyone reading this who think they might have a problem with alcohol. Give it a try and join us in our road to a healthier existence.

Fantastic Tool for Support — Reframe has been a great tool to support my backing down on alcohol consumption. I actually am using it as a resource during my alcohol “fast” during lent and while I don’t believe I am addicted, it has definitely changed my thought and my relationship with alcohol. Addiction runs in the family and I am glad there is an easily accessible tool in place to keep me mindful of my patterns and consumption so that I can live a life where I CAN continue to enjoy a glass of wine on occasions and not be dependent on it for all occasions. I highly recommend Reframe for anyone looking to cut back on alcohol or cut it out entirely. It is really well created.

This works for me! — My primary care doctor recommended Reframe. I have tried so many things to quit alcohol, without success. Reframe works for me. The daily exercises are not overwhelming. The online meetings are good (and low pressure).  Reframe encourages a wide variety of interventions; pick some and see if they work for you. I especially love the progress section in my profile, which shows how long I have been alcohol free, to the second. It also shows how much money I have saved and how many calories from alcohol I have avoided. The support staff respond within a day to questions you might have. Happy to have found this!

Standing Ovation — That's what I give this app. If you have concerns about your drinking habits, do yourself a favor and get this app. It's components have EVERYTHING covered. Brain science, coaches (if you like) self care, community, positive reinforcement, etc.. There is no judgement just encouragement. No one will tell you that you must completely abstain or label you. You choose your goals and the app is there for you. It may be the best thing I've ever done for my mental health, my physical health and my happiness. I seriously look forward to doing my daily check in each morning. If you're ready to change your relationship with alcohol, this is your new best friend.

This helped me beyond my alcohol issues — This app digs deep into self growth as a way of controlling drinking habits. It has many dynamic lessons day by day that don’t take longer than 15 minutes. There’s different tools and a forum where you can talk to other people going through the same issue as well as just scroll and read people’s stories. This app has changed my life and I am glad I am paying for this, it’s the best investment I have ever made. It’s not an easy journey and the Reframe crew makes you feel more at ease and motivates you day by day to not only control your drinking but also to become a better person.

Excellent resource, highly recommend — Whatever your experience with alcohol, if you are looking to cutback or quit, this is the place. For me, learning about the science behind why we drink, what it does to our brains, and that the damage can be reversed is very empowering and gives me hope. Journaling and other exercises help engage my brain. Logging drinks helps keep me accountable to myself. Forums help me connect with others that I can learn from and support. Zoom calls are a great feature: I can sit and watch others talk about their journey, or I can raise my hand and participate. There are other resources in the app I haven’t even begun to touch!

I used this app 2 years ago but stopped — Used to be free so I stopped using it when I couldn’t even log in when they started charging all of a sudden, it’s been 2 years and now it looks like it’s more complicated than before, it used to be more simple but now it has so much information and forums, it makes me feel overwhelmed.  There’s rarely any free apps now a days so I’m giving this a try, even if I have to pay. It’s better than keep ruining my life with alcohol.  I just wish it the app was more simple like before. I’m on day 3 of sobriety and I’m feeling very paranoid, anxious and this information overload is kind of stressful so I’m only gonna use the daily task, all the other things my brain can’t take right now.

Cutting back — I have been using Reframe now for a month. My goal is to cut back on my daily use of alcohol. I’m not a big drinker, but I can hit a binge and I want that to never happen again. From the very beginning the information about alcohol and how it affects our brain gave many aha moments and showed me why several of my cravings and triggers were getting me into trouble. It was exactly what I needed. The daily routine of the App and the exercises are thought provoking and have helped me see my path forward. In one month I have cut back and I feel GREAT, both physically and mentally. For me, it has been a godsend. Highly recommend it.

I recommend something more reliable — This app promises a lot but fails to deliver. It is FULL of bugs and has consistently been so since I joined 5 or 6 months ago. Some of my data that I worked hard on just disappeared tonight - not only is that frustrating, but if you’re counting on this as a tool to help you navigate an already challenge behavior change, it’s doubly frustrating. I cannot in good faith recommend this app to anyone seeking reliable tools to help them change their relationship with alcohol. Reliability should be a baseline feature but this app even fails that. Less concerning but also super annoying is that this app is very poorly organized, not intuitive, confusing, etc., and I’m a pretty tech savvy person. So there’s that, too! Try something better!

This app really works! — As we age, too much liquor is a big risk to our physical and mental health.  After losing some relatives to alcohol induced dementia, I’ve been committed to a big reduction in my unhealthy consumption of alcohol.   After many failed attempts I came across this app. What a godsend!   I’ve cut my consumption to one third of my level before starting the app.  The tools are very helpful and the developer clearly understands how to help people through this difficult process.   Many thanks to the developers for such a great service.   Interestingly, I saved enough in the first week from reduced wine purchases to justify purchase of the app!

Helpful, informative, non-judgmental — I am very much enjoying this app and finding it very helpful. I am not one to pay for apps in general, but finally took the plunge on trying this one to see if it would help me out. Reframe is great at giving the TLDR version of scientific research on alcohol and the effects on the body systems and the psychology behind it- making it very digestible for any and all users. The platform is structured to be supportive and without shame on alcohol use or slip ups. I like the ability to add and remove certain exercises as well, tailoring your experience- also use it as a cut back tool or a quit tool.

The only app you’ll need to either go dry or damp — I exhaustively researched and tried many different apps when I decided to address my alcohol over-usage. I’ve since dropped all the other apps, and this one is by far the only one that consistently works and adds value to your life. Based on science and research by experts, with a very healthy dose of social, physical, and psychological input… I’ve gone from a habit that was ruining my life to a full re-set that has delighted my family and given me my joy and purpose back. Reframe has saved my life, handed it back to me and for that, I will be forever grateful. Thank you Reframe!

A truly wonderful app. — Reframe is turning my life around. There is a load of information and science to explain exactly why we get addicted to alcohol. It’s such a “quick fix”. But you discover that there are other quick fixes that are just as good, and much healthier. Plus, you don’t have to stop drinking. You just learn that you can wind it down a bit. And the app’s tools and forum of other drinkers help so much. I feel like I’m totally surrounded by people with the same issue - all rooting for me and vice-versa. This app is a Godsend. Finally, a lifelong habit of heavy drinking is turning a corner. Honestly, I never thought it could happen❣️

Truly life changing — I’ve never rated an app before, but I feel compelled to share my love for this app. This app has not only changed my relationship with alcohol but has helped me in all areas of my life. I look forward to waking up every morning and completing my module for the day. The content is science based with the latest research and information to help you on your journey…no matter where you’re at and what your goals are. Some things in life are worth the cost and paying for an annual membership for this app is more than worth it if you are committed to changing your relationship with alcohol.

Life changing, truly — This app and community has TRULY been life changing for me. I can’t believe I took a chance and downloaded the app, did the free trial, and ZERO regrets and have happily paid for the next 12 months because of how blown away I am by Reframe. The app content, the community, zoom meetings, coaches, fellow reframers, everything- I have become the best version of myself because of all the above supporting and facilitating me every step of the way! Took a chance and boy did it work out for me! You get this one life, if you’re on the fence, there’s really no reason not to *try* and just see what it’s about!

Definitely glad I tried this. — It took a long time for me to want to change my relationship with alcohol because I thought it was an “all or nothing” situation.  But I was exhausted from the rollercoaster of hung-over me saying new day, no drinking, and afternoon me saying- let’s drink!   This app was such a positive surprise, helping create new habits and -this sounds bad- but I really thought I had heard it all about drinking and shocker, I had not.  Embarrassing.   The educational science and psychology that they share, in easy bites, has been a huge game changer.   It makes me think and it makes me relax.  And without all the judgement or shame.

Surprisingly helpful right away — I paid for a full year subscription, thinking the daily tasks and reflections would be good for me no matter what. Was really impressed right away with the science-based reminders—in bite sized chunks—of how cutting back on alcohol has SOOO many benefits. Daily little motivations like this have led to me actually not wanting my regular glass or two of wine per night—which felt impossible before—and being very happy with a mocktail instead. I’m less than one month into the program and feel so empowered to say ‘no’ to friends who want me to drink , and physically and mentally feeling so much better.

Extremely helpful — This app is extremely helpful. It uses structured, easy-to-use, evidence-based approaches to reduce harmful consumption. I find myself with more self-compassion, being more mindful, and making positive changes for myself. My mood and my health have already improved in less than a week.   This is a very well designed app and worth the money. You would spend a great deal of time and effort gathering these resources yourself, but they are helpfully collected here so you can actually use them and immediately benefit from them.  Please keep up the awesome effort at improving the world’s relationship with alcohol!

Life changing — This app has helped me get my life back.  I am a mom in my 30s and wanted to be more present for my kids. I was having a wind down drink almost every evening after work. I felt in control but I also felt out of control. I was over the feeling of guilt in the mornings and wanted to set a better example for my kids. I could quickly see a change for the better after a few days of not drinking. I felt empowered. Reframe is a fantastic tool to use when you make the decision to change your relationship with drinking. I tried a few apps and this was the one for me. Worth it.

Speechless. — I’m not one to leave reviews. But, this app is different. It’s been a week. I feel validated. I feel respected. I feel like it will be okay, I will be okay. Please, if you have any doubts. Don’t. This app helps and treats you and your relationship with alcohol as it really should be. Different and unique. Everyone’s journey is just that. To each their own. This app proved itself more effective than any other treatment or group for these kinds of issues… As an addictions counselor who recently graduated from university, even I couldn’t pull myself out of the hole I was starting to dig. But, this app is working so far.

Brilliant App! Informative & Motivating, Bravo!! — Initially my intentions going in were to cut back/take a break. I made the commitment to check in with the Reframe app every day for the month of December and complete all tasks and reading (compactly informative and do-able!!).  It is the 28th, and I’m excited to dabble with living Alcohol-Free for 2024. I’m 28 days in my journey and honestly don’t miss it. You learn quickly healthy coping techniques, how to gain positive support, identify triggers and steps to manage them. My personal favorite is all the new knowledge I am equipped with and my daily health update! I honestly can say I look forward to using Reframe daily.

So glitchy — Love the potential of the app and the content, but so much of it is glitchy. The daily calendar shows I’ve been alcohol free for 36 days, but the total tracker shows I’ve been alcohol free for 0 days, weeks, months, years. Many of the readings are cut off at the bottom of the page and I can’t read the rest of the article. One of the daily tasks was to watch a video and the video was “inaccessible because it’s private”. I’ve reached out to their support team multiple times and the only assistance I’ve received is to close and reopen the app, which does nothing. It’s really disappointing to pay for the app and have much of it be inaccessible and the support team ignore my requests for help.

Helpful app — I find this to be a helpful app, WITH outside support. It’s a great add on to the weekly meetings I have with a Kaiser group, and with friends who I talk to. Trying to make any change is hard to do alone, so this has served as a good check in with myself. The daily readings are great.   The one improvement to this app is in the ‘log your mood’ journal entry section. Please add auto correct or predictive text! It would be great if im corrected to I’m and other spelling / grammar mistakes. I want to be able to write stream of consciousness without having to back space to correct grammatical errors that will annoy me or not make sense when I go back to read my previous entries.

Great app! — If you’re looking to change your relationship with alcohol and learn more about yourself in the process, give this app a try. I was skeptical about whether or not it would help me cutback on my drinking & started with a “Dry January” challenge. I’ve learned so much about the psychology behind my drinking & am proud to say I am continuing my journey using the app & am now 108 days sober! I don’t know that I’ll never drink again, that wasn’t really my goal. I do know my relationship with alcohol has changed & so has my overall wellbeing. I believe it is thanks to the lessons, resources & tools available through this app.

Excellent Support For Cutting Back — This app not only helps you track alcohol consumption, but gives you daily support on a number of other factors that influence drinking or not drinking.  It helps encourage and motivate you to reach your goals, as well as be gentle in overcoming the shame of drinking and even the shame in not drinking! I love that it gives the science and the “why” we drink, but that it also gives tools to work for each individual.  It has changed my alcohol use as well as the way I see alcohol in life in general, in so many great ways, and I am living a better life because of it! Thank you Reframe!

Big Help!! — This has been a great help to me in my battle to quit drinking daily and to save it for a night out or a weekend. Wonderful information and very motivating!!! This app not only addresses drinking but can help you in every aspect of your life! It doesn’t take long to do the app everyday and it really is helpful in dealing with your problems.  I am losing weight too and everything that applies to drinking applies to overeating. It’s just another addiction.  I have another app for weight loss but I like reframe the best.  I think it’s wonderful to be able to be in a group on line and get support and encouragement there. Go Reframe!!!

GREAT App to help with Alcohol Reduction — I am trying to reduce my alcohol consumption  ( not necessarily stop) so in the journey Reframe has provided incredible encouragement, support and for me, scientific help with tips and facts about what alcohol does to the mind, spirit and body- and just as important  what one experiences during a decrease (urges for other foods, irritability, etc) to help understand it isn’t the person but simply the process! That was HUGE for me .Also seeing a visual representation of my “alcohol free” days on the calendar gives me encouragement for another day.  If anyone compares what we spend on alcohol vs. the price of the app- it’s a no brainer, even if it just reduces the number of drinks by 2 -3 per week.

You Like This — I’ve been using Reframe for a few months now, and it’s been fantastic so far.  It’s very flexible in that you can set your own alcohol reduction goal. There truly is a wealth of information that is provided in manageable daily portions. I am grateful for having learned and incorporated a great deal of practical information. My favorite category of information has been the neuroscience. While I think we all generally understand that too much drinking is unhealthy and can damage our mental capacity, the information on healing the brain and significantly improving cognition has been a Godsend.

Helpful for cutting back — I don't think this is the app for anyone truly suffering from addiction. If you want to be more aware of your relationship with alcohol and work on cutting back usage, I think it's great. It reminds me a bit of a weight watchers program-- logging your drinks and holding yourself accountable to that is a great tool for really focusing on how much alcohol you're indulging in during a week. It also keeps it at the fore front of your mind, so you may consider what drinks are really "worth it". I think it's a useful tool in conjunction with therapy and/or meetings for those serious about confronting their bad habits.

Game Changer — I’m so grateful that my friend Rachel found this app. It encompasses so many resources that I have found helpful. I did the daily activities for both dry and damp January and what j enjoyed the most were Kevin’s videos. I wish we had him for February. I was unsuccessful with dry January so it was refreshing to have an option. His videos were helpful to dry or damp reframes. Please bring Kevin’s daily videos back for February!  Thanks to whomever brought Reframe to the world. I count on it every day and it, along with Alan Carr’s book, “Quit Drinking Without Willpower,” have truly helped me make changes to my relationship with alcohol.

BBB… — I paid for the $4.99 trial month to see if I would like this app only to find out the whole app is $120 which is WAAAY out of my budget, and more than double that if you pay by the month so I froze my credit card so I wasn’t accidentally charged. Not only did they try running my card a day before it was supposed to but they tried rerunning it a couple days later. Was mad they tried charging after canceling and still trying to charge me, I then deleted my entire account. A week later I was notified that they tried charging my card again so I guess now I will have to place a complaint with the Better Business Bureau. Not everyone has hundreds and hundreds to spend on apps. Stop!! Update 2/27: you tried charging my card for the 4th time!! I wrote to that email and was ignored!

Like a Good Friend with a Quick Daily Reminder — So far Reframe has been the quick daily reminder I need to just cut back. Not finish the dregs of that beer I’m not really enjoying and not to have that last beer right before bed because I’m bored. It’s also taught me a lot and been an ironically familiar educator on some of the little things going on with my body and mind, which I hadn’t before connected to alcohol consumption, like depletion of dopamine or the numbing sensation I get in my toes when I ski. Maybe it’s a coincidence, but I’m guessing these things are connected and I wouldn’t have put it together without Reframe.

This is the best money I ever spent — There is so many things available on the site— the benefits seem endless—This site is interactive with real people— real meetings!  The coaches are ALL awesome.  People who truly care and you are not just a number— they get to know you- ( if you want them too) or you can be as incognito as you desire). Whatever it is you need — it’s there.  And if things change and you have different needs that’s ok— there is always someone there going through what you are going to.  This site has considerably has changed my mental health for the better.

Game changer — This app has been a game changer in my fight to cut down and control my alcohol consumption. Awareness is power and key to change. My ability to track and be aware of how much drink daily has brought to the forefront for me. I also enjoy the facts regarding how alcohol negatively impacts my overall health and ability to accomplish my life goals. I enjoy the daily motivation and tips on how to deal with social situations where drinking is the norm and expected which is most! I love it all and recommend to anyone who wants cut down alcohol intake or delete completely. PS - the group zoom are the sweet icing on the cake.

Life changer — So I am not necessarily an alcoholic. But when I drink wine I have a hard time stopping at one glass or two glasses. And every morning after I’ve had several glasses I regret it and pour out anything that’s left. I’ve done this countless times promising myself that I will cut back and only drink on occasion. Then at the end of the day on the way home from work I find myself buying another bottle of wine. I realize that I couldn’t do this by myself. I found this app and it has been amazing. It holds me accountable and I am nearly a month in and have met my goals and then some. Thank you Reframe!

Best thing for sobriety since sliced bread and the toaster — I start each day with this app and the daily activities that I have to do. The information that I read is very informative, science based and keeps me from even thinking about drinking alcohol. The forum community is great, makes you feel that you are not alone on your sober journey. I am very grateful to stumble upon this app when I needed it most. I would even be willing to pay more money for its benefits and daily use. They saved me 40 days of expanse on alcohol so far and helped me regain control of my life. Can’t put a price on that!

Highly Recommend! — If anyone wants to stop drinking or lessen their drinking, this app is for you. It covers all aspects of why we drink: cognitive, social, emotional, and psychological. My favorite part is the knowledge it gives me in a daily basis of what alcohol does to us in a moment and over time. The teachings are what I remember when I have a craving.   I turned to the app due to high anxiety and trouble sleeping. My anxiety is multitudes better as well as my sleeping so I’m functioning better in the day.   The cost is worth it because it’s not that expensive in the long run since the app helps you buy less alcohol!

So helpful — I’ve struggled with cutting back and realized me and my loved ones are better off completely quitting. Whether you’re looking for assistance in either, this app holds you accountable and doesn’t let you put your health on the back burner. So informative, daily tasks/ motivation. This doesn’t feel as daunting as other programs I’ve tried. It gets me ready to take on my day and the challenges life is going to throw at me with a better understanding of what is going on in my brain when I do feel the need to numb. Total change of pace. Highly recommend.

Great sober companion — I love this app. It is a part of my routine every morning to help me focus on maintaining a sober lifestyle. There are so many great tools within this app including excellent education about the psychology of living well, help with cravings, community features to connect with others on the same journey, and a day counter to help track your progress.   I highly recommend this app. The developers have created something very special and clearly understand all of the challenges of getting and maintaining a sober lifestyle and being happy while doing it. Thanks Reframe for creating this tool!

Reframe works — I am so grateful my daughter recommended me toReframe. It truly helped change the way my brain responds to alcohol and I found that by using the apps, attending the pop-up meetings, and the practices and daily readings really helped coach me to have self-control. I recommend this app to anyone who does not feel attending a 12 Step program and is willing to truly better themselves using these program tools. They truly do work if you work them. Thank you so much for helping me reframe my mind regarding alcohol intake. I feel healthier and happier & more focused on enjoying my life🙏🏽

This app is awesome!! — The neuroscience in this app is awesome. The forum for discussion is awesome. The ability to work on yourself without feeling shame & guilt is awesome. Really enjoying every aspect of the app. The ability to work on an abstinence or cut back track is awesome. Can’t speak highly enough about it. Already have recommended to one person and will recommend to anyone else I feel that it could help. Has been a super helpful tool!! One small thing that I have noticed is misplaced words that make sentences read funny but I figure it’s something to just help my perfectionist self grow!

SO supportive! — I use this app to reign myself in after vacations and time off work.  The health updates are my fave.  They let me know that each day without alcohol is productive on a health level.  I look forward to logging my 0 drinks days and when I log a drink, the app doesn’t shame me in ANY way.  As a matter of fact, if a weekend has some drinks in it, the app might recommend that I make my goal more reasonable.  Thank you Reframe for offering a user friendly accountability tool, as well as accurate health related information to go along with my progress.

Truly life changing — I cannot recommend this app enough. The program is extremely effective in supporting goals to become healthier and cut back on drinking. Ive learned so much about the negative effects of alcohol on our mental & physical health, and was inspired through learning to change my lifestyle for the better. I’ve gained clarity, energy, and happiness through following this program closely. After 3 months I felt that I had all the tools to continue without it. I sincerely think this may have changed my relationship to drinking for life. Highly recommend it.

Such a great tool I’m so thankful to have!! — The daily tasks in the app are absolutely amazing how well they help start out my day! They provide amazing scientific information and great insight into addiction and how alcohol effects us.  This reinforcement is so helpful to have in my pocket.    It’s also great to have the craving tool with me wherever I go and that has helped me get through several urges I’ve had by using the meditation tools provided (and the games!!).   I can’t recommend this tool enough for anyone looking to take a break from alcohol or has taken an extended break already (I’m 18 months alcohol free and use it every day).

Amazing System within!! — This app is the best sobriety app. Doesn’t appear to be for anything but alcohol just an fyi but this app is the most complete and comprehensive program available. I did the full year payment and it’s truly worth every dime!! There are so many tools of different types in this app from live and real two-way community meetings to games to play when you have cravings, there are regular challenges, reading tools journal tools the list goes on!! I’ve done 3 different sobriety apps and this one is hands down the best there is. Grateful for the reframe team!!

Like Going To AA Meetings But on Your Phone — I wish I had seen this app years ago. I’m not saying it’s impossible to do it alone but it’s virtually impossible to do it alone. You’re fighting your brain and your brain wants alchocol. You need people to help you stay strong and for most people, including myself, going to live AA meetings is too daunting.  This app is like having meetings on your phone. I love scrolling through the live feed where people can write your thoughts and you see people struggling with the exact same problem as you, even worse.  Everyday, you get 3-5 minutes of reading explaining, in detail, your problem and exactly what is going on in your body. It makes life 10x easier when you read this and helps the cravings lesson.   The amount you pay per month will pay for itself in literally 1-2 days of being alcohol free. It’s a worthy investment. I truly think this app might be my secret weapon moving forward.

Highly recommend — As a person who has been abusing alcohol the past ten years and went to a high end rehab in Southern Cal on the beach, this app has all the education, support and structure my as they $30,000 a month rehab offered.   The tools provided and the set up is perfect. I am also a retired business manager so I can recognize good structure when I see it. I paid less than $100 for my membership plan. Well worth it.  I highly recommend Reframe.  Reach out, start the journey to find the old you or create a new better version of yourself!!  It works! #Campinggirl

Very helpful — On my journey to try to stop drinking, I have failed many times , and is hard to do it alone. Alcohol caused me lots of trouble and horrible experiences. I saw Reframe app and I decided to give it a try. I’m glad I did because I’ve learned a lot about how alcohol affects my brain and this has been very interesting to learn in order to have more reasons to quit drinking. The daily tasks and their info are amazing, the forum an chats are very good to use and realize your not alone , and to find support.  I definitely highly recommend you to give it a try! Thank you Reframe team!

Great tool for sobriety — I’ve been in recovery for over 3 years but I’m always on the lookout for new tools to add to my sobriety toolbox. So far, digital sponsor has been an awesome addition. Compared to other addiction recovery apps I’ve used, Digital Sponsor is way more comprehensive and has a ton of sobriety tools I didn’t even know I needed! I really love the set up and how it is task-driven on a daily basis. Makes the whole “one day at a time” thing ring even more true. Highly suggest for anybody who wants to up their recovery game or is just looking for a great new tool to add to compliment their sober lifestyle

Grateful for this app — I found the reframe app to be incredibly helpful, intuitive, and user-friendly. With daily check ins, science based tutorials, and inspirational guidance, I was able to greatly reduce my weekly drinking and reach my target goals. I went from drinking a few drinks almost every night, to under three drinks per week. I feel more clear, more energized, my sleep is better, my relationship relationships with my wife and kids are in the best place I’ve ever been. I highly recommend this app for someone who is attempting to cut back their alcohol intake.

Simply life changing. — Neuroscience is the way to go. This app not only provides every tool -- self-reflection, support meetings, community, + craving calmers -- to help you slow down or stop... it also teaches ways to heal your body & mind from the damage alcohol inevitably causes to everyone who uses frequently. It shows you why you should be gentle on yourself when "just stopping" doesn't always happen overnight.   It is truly life changing. It is the best investment you can make for yourself. And while it may seem pricey - it is much cheaper than a weekend at the bar.

I have to update my review — I love this app. It has been very effective in helping me move forward in my freedom from alcohol & other problem habits & behaviors that I used to cope. I have used it for 1 1/2yrs.  The best part was the meetings. Coaches were awesome, helpful, encouraging and reliable.  Trust in recovery is huge for me. But now I am finding it difficult to stay. Coaches come & go quickly like a revolving door. There have been several long term beloved coaches just fired without the membership/community having any idea what is going on.  It’s just mind boggling.  Sad that management can’t get their employer relationships straightened out. The program is great. The coaches are great, they just don’t stay. WHY?

Brilliantly created — I have nothing but good words to say about this app. Reframe is for anyone having difficulty cutting down in their drinking or becoming alcohol free. This app uses coping methods, meditations videos, courses and there are several live community zoom meetings every day that are open to talk in or leave your video off and just listen. Neuroscience is the foundation. It is primarily for alcohol and changing our relationship with it however, the Reframe app works in every part of our life that is in need of rethinking, of reframing. I can’t say enough. So very glad this has arrived!

Life changing whether cutting back or going sober — I've never reviewed an app before and I'm an app junkie. Reframe has completely changed my life. I went from cutting down drinking to just 2 per week to going sober in August 2022. The app has every tool to learn the truth about alcohol without scaring you or making you adopt a new religion. It has daily (quick) tasks to reinforce behavior and adopt healthy habits. And I've met new "friends" through the forum, some even local. It's an amazing tool and I share it with every person who mentions they're reevaluating their relationship with booze.

Awesome Resource for Transformation — Reframe is a smart, compassionate, and fact-based app that can help you transform your relationship with alcohol and how you process emotions, stress, etc. The app offers an abundance of resources for those who want to be more introspective, live a healthier life, and carve a better path for themselves. If less or no alcohol is something that would benefit you or your life, then I highly recommend using the app for a 1000 Hours Dry or 30 Day Challenge. It really helped me reset out of unhealthy routines I created when covid interrupted our lives. Highly recommend this app!

The Help YOU need — For me, Reframe stands out as a comprehensive support system for anyone looking to build a healthier relationship with alcohol. What makes this app particularly impressive is how it combines science-based approaches with cutting-edge technology.  The daily check-ins and mood tracking help you understand your triggers and patterns, while the educational content explains the science behind alcohol's effects on your body and mind. What sets Reframe apart is its innovative use of AI technology – the app provides personalized, insightful responses to your journal entries and reflections, making it feel like you have a supportive, understanding coach who truly "gets" your unique situation.  The app's text-to-speech feature deserves special mention. Instead of the robotic voices common in many apps, Reframe uses remarkably natural-sounding voice technology that makes the content feel more engaging and personal. Whether you're listening to daily lessons or motivational content, the realistic voice narration makes the experience feel more like a conversation with a caring friend than a digital tool.  The mix of cognitive behavioral therapy techniques and mindfulness exercises provide real alternatives to drinking, while the progress tracking features help visualize your achievements. The emergency toolkit is particularly thoughtful for handling challenging moments.  The community aspect provides a judgment-free space to connect with others on similar journeys, which helps reduce the isolation many feel when changing their drinking habits. The AI-enhanced interaction adds another layer of support, offering personalized insights and encouragement based on your specific entries and progress.  While the subscription cost might seem significant to some, the sophisticated technology, comprehensive support, and daily guidance make it a worthwhile investment in your health and wellbeing. It's like having both a knowledgeable coach and an empathetic friend in your pocket

Reframe your thinking. — This app is helping me a lot as I read about the brain science of addiction. I like the calming meditations and the games. There are some things I don’t know how to do such as the hippo game for distracting me from myself and my drinking thoughts. There are a lot of cool ways to change my thoughts, and distract me in the immediate moment of my “lunacy” of wanting to drink when I really just need a meal, or a walk, or a friend to talk to. I am a very deliberate introvert, one who doesn’t like to be seen or heard, I like that there are forums to go to for listening and not needing to be seen or heard.

Awesome tool — Downloaded this to use during Dry January and zero regrets. I love all the different ways it helps to track and journal and most importantly, actually give the raw truth about alcohol, without sugar coating it like the rim of a daiquiri. This is knowledge everyone should have and I wish this would be a requirement before anyone is allowed to drink. Without knowing the true effects alcohol has on our bodies we are essentially getting behind the wheel without passing a drivers exam. Thank you, Kayla, for creating something so helpful at a time when it is needed most!

Great for casual drinkers — I used to drink heavily in my teens and 20s, then successfully moderated in my 30s. In my 40s, due to health concerns, I decided it was time to give it up. I thought it would be really hard to give up that glass of wine with dinner so I decided to try this app for a free week. Within 2 days I decided to pay for a subscription. This app makes it SO MUCH EASIER to reach your goals, whether it’s moderation or alcohol free. The neuroscience is top notch and they know how to help you change and form habits and support you along the way. Highly recommend you give it a try.

Changed my life — I can say with 100% honesty and confidence that Reframe has changed my life completely. Next week will be a full year of being alcohol-free and while I did the work myself Reframe gave me the tools to get here.   When I first started on this journey it was a dark, confusing and lonely place- Reframe gave me the support and tools I need to get this far and actually gave me something to look forward to everyday on this journey. If you are thinking of quitting drinking or slowing down drinking this app is incredible but like any tool it’s how you use it.

Really useful — Good app, genuinely had interesting engagement activities and things that made me want to log in every day. I cut my weekly drinking by half in the month I used it. I wish there was a month to month option; I realize they have to make money though. But the annual option is a lot up-front when I’ve been cutting back on expenses with the cost of living lately. I know alcohol is more expensive but I’m going to see if I can do it myself for a bit. Between daycare, housing, and food costs I might get priced out of alcohol too, frankly

Was skeptical at first, but totally worth it! — I’ve tried 4 times previously to quit drinking; I thought it was black and white - simply a struggle all about will power. Since joining Reframe, I have gained so much understanding for my relationship with alcohol, and I now realize that making a change is not just a decision  -  it is 100% an ongoing process.  Reframe has given me the support of REAL people and the education and the tools to help stay the course. It’s also very convenient/flexible and affordable, which is a serious bonus. I would absolutely recommend Reframe!

Just try… — Trust me if you’re thinking about it, just try. This is a great app, it’s intuitive, informative, very well organized and designed. And as a long term addict, who’s been in a few different versions of recovery program this is, in my opinion, a wonderful resource.   The unique thing about Reframe is that it’s not necessary an abstinence program. It’s open to and good for those of us who are trying cut back, as well as those who want to quit, and everyone in between.   You will gain a better understanding of yourself,  your drinking and life in general. Good luck!

Great app but way too expensive — I did the free trial. I’m one of those people who occasionally likes to stop drinking for 2-4 weeks just to reset. Right now, I’m not trying to completely quit, just cut back during the week. Maybe this app is better for people who are totally quitting? There’s some good content but I just can’t wrap my head around the price. I pay less for other apps I use far more often. Note to users- you have to pay extra for any counseling or whatnot. Not a fan of earning coins, etc. There’s nothing about this app that justifies the price point. The info I received on the daily is stuff you can Google about how alcohol affects the brain/body.

Helpful in conjunction with other treatment — I downloaded this app when I began my journey to sobriety. It has helped me gain awareness. The scientific information is incredibly useful and makes me feel comforted in the fact that my alcoholism is a health condition and not a character defect. I love the meditations. All of that said, I am in AA, and that is contributing largely to my sobriety. However Reframe helps keep me on track, and helps me feel more rounded and not completely dependent on the AA program. I recommend using it with a twelve step program or other kind of therapy or maybe outpatient treatment.

Making changes! — I love this app! I downloaded it to help support my decision to reduce my consumption so I could lose weight and improve my health. The approach is great and doing it daily makes such a difference. I am about a month in and notice a difference on the days I don’t carve out time to check in. Even though my goal was to reduce my consumption I’m almost 1 mo alcohol free! It is very doable and short time commitment but very effective. I only wish they had an app that included this same approach to weight-loss/food relationships because the mindfulness/CBT really works!

Very Well Done! — This app is very well pulled together. The daily tasks start you off in a good frame of mind, and the info is presented clearly without being dumbed down or the same old thing we have heard before. The daily activities are not so big to be daunting. The tracking is really helpful, much more so than just keeping it in your mind. Seeing it visually has more impact. While there is an option to share your info with others, they don’t harass you if you chose not to. I am very impressed and motivated to keep on with it.

Amazing — I wasn’t sure what to expect from The Reframe App. I saw it promoted by previous people on IG so I decided to try the 7 day free trial. So far I absolutely love it! The daily prompts help me journal and focus my thoughts and my “Why”. There is a place to chat with others, there are places to go to help you get through cravings or triggers, I love so many things about it! This app is SO well thought out. I highly recommend it to anyone who is looking to either cut back on drinking or quit completely. Thank you so much Reframe! I am feeling so much more confident in my pursuit of sobriety.

Just fantastic no matter you journey — I never leave reviews but feel compelled to do so. This app is nearly perfect. No matter your reason to consider, it’s got the right set of tools to support you. The technology is easy and intuitive. The routine for checking in is simple and habit forming (in a good way). The insights are amazing and truly helpful. The community is active, supportive, and eye opening.   Only wishlist items: (1) apple health integration; (2) mechanism to donate the full version to someone in need. Even without these, still a 5-star product.

Never thought it would help. But it really does. — After drinking at least a couple drinks (usually more) pretty much every day for a few years now, I didn’t think an app could do anything for me.  I recently began to realize that I actually look forward to reading through and completing each days “tasks” and articles. Even if it is just opening the app some days. It may sound crazy but this builds a pattern and sense of responsibility that grows. After only a week, I began to feel a sense of control again.

Scummy business practice — This company while started off I felt provided value after the first 2 weeks the lessons became repetitive and provided no real support or value. I went to cancel 2 weeks ago. The next day I checked and it still showed I hadn’t canceled so I tried again. Same thing. Tried a 3rd time and this time I got an email saying it was canceled. This was 4 or 5 days ago. Today I was charged 120 dollars by reframe for a year subscription. First of all it should be way easier to cancel then they make it and second when someone cancels let them cancel. Don’t still charge me like I want this crappy service. I would never recommend this company as all they want is the money they provide no real value and it’s scummy how hard they make it to cancel

Real-life application skills to break unhealthy patterns with alcohol once and for all! — I have tried several ways over the past 7 years to get (and stay) sober.  For me, introducing the Reframe app (plus therapy) has been a game changer!  I appreciate multiple schools of thought surrounding the idea of sobriety, and I use tools from many paths that accumulate and empower me.  If you haven’t given Reframe a chance, I highly encourage you to do so.  It’s real-life application skills to put in your toolbox to unravel a complex tangle and start living a life of freedom we all deserve so fully!  ✨✨✨

Case a day to occasional drink — Needed something to hold myself accountable.  Just realizing the amount of alcohol I put through my system floored me (no pun intended).   I tried to Erase a few things After 25 years and three branches of service.   New baby (yes I’m an old dad) and an oncologist begging me to stop I thought it might be a good idea.  9 months ago around a Case a day and now a drink or two a month.  I guess it was the accountability prompt that had me track my drinks that helped the most.  Also wanted to be around to see This little man sitting in my lap.    Thanks reframe

Very useful/helpful — This app has been very helpful, useful, and informative.  The information it provides about the science of what alcohol does to your body and mind is excellent.  I particularly like the overview section where the app tells you how much money you have saved and how many calories you have avoided.  It also tells you the positive changes that are happening in your body as the days of no alcohol pass.  It’s easy to quantify your results with this app.  I highly recommend this app to anyone looking to cut back or quit drinking

A New Approach to Alcohol — After decades of believing that only some people are susceptible to losing control of how alcohol shows up in there lives, Reframe has totally changed my thinking.   Without shame, blame, or self-deprecating confessions of powerlessness, Reframe shifts the paradigm by showing that anyone who drinks can become emotionally and physically dependent on ethanol (the same chemical additive that fuels your car.) The folks at Reframe shine light on the neurophysiological effects of alcohol - effects to which ALL humans are susceptible, not just broken ones. They also expose powerful sociocultural influences that elevate drinking in every life context, as well as alcohol’s ubiquitous and highly profitable marketing machine.   The Reframe App provides education, interactive activities, great podcasts, community support, and much more.    Whether you’re considering cutting back or quitting drinking altogether, or you’re just “sober curious,” I highly recommend the Reframe App.

I’ve tried quitting many times…. — And this is the first app I’ve found that actually helps in that process. As someone that enjoys counting the days I’ve gone without a drink and checking things off my list, this app is perfect for that. Not only does it help by giving daily scientifically based facts about what alcohol does to your body, it also gives tips on coping with cravings, meditations, and even simple games you can play to work through the cravings until they pass. To say I love this app would be an understatement!

The BEST! — I honestly can not say enough good things about this app. I’ve tried to quit drinking many times beforehand and it wasn’t until I downloaded this app that I was finally able to stop. You learn the science behind the how and why of alcohol and it’s effects on the body. You learn ways to cope with cravings. You have a community to connect with that understands what you are going through. Plus health updates of how your body is healing the longer you stay alcohol free. This app has changed my life and I will be forever grateful for its existence.

A great resource — The Reframe APP has developed into an extremely useful tool to help me minimize the importance of wine in my life. Daily lessons on the effects of alcohol on all bodily, emotional, cogitation and relational aspects of your life. Tools to help you cope with anxiety, depression and some of the lighter withdrawal symptoms. (Reframe makes it clear if you are a all day, daily drinker you should seek medical assistance so you do suffer from severe withdrawal). With its upgrades, the APP is easy to use. I highly recommend this APP to anyone who is thinking about or knows they want to change their relationship with alcohol.

A God send for those of us that feel to embarrassed to go to groups or cannot afford therapy! — I’m 52 and used to drink a 5th of booze a day at the worst of it. I’ve tried so many times to stop or cut back. Never takes. This is by far the longest time sober. For me, understanding how my brain and body connected with booze as well as the group of like minded folks in chat and so many good tools to help stay off the drink!  This tool gives you the education to not just understand why you drink and how to stop but also tools to improve your life and relationships. Amazing!

This app helps! — I’ve been on a conscious attempt to control/moderate/quit drinking for a bit over a year. I’ve read tons of books, joined online support groups, but have struggled to maintain sobriety or find a sense of control. Since I started using this app, my desire to drink has decreased substantially, and I find it easier and easier to go alcohol free for days at a time. I love the daily exercises and all the tools and resources the app provides. If you are interested in regaining control of your relationship with alcohol, I highly recommend this app.

Incredibly Hard to Cancel — The reviews are great and the product sounds great, I never got the chance to try it because when I signed up, the timing wasn’t right with my schedule and so I wanted to pause and cancel, but that became incredibly difficult. if your product is so great put a cancel button otherwise you lead one to believe it’s all fluff.  Try to cancel after signing up for the three day free trial. You cant’t on App and the product will not show in your app subscriptions during this trial period so you can not cancel until AFTER you have been charged.  The app should be removed from the App Store until it has an easy to remove button. It kept trying to charge my bank account, took me weeks to finally get it to cancel.

The “Coin” system is flawed. — Why can’t I access all of the courses when I want? The coin system is keeping me from getting information that could help me right now.
