For instance I started an introduction course on triggers, but I want to use the self soothing course as well so I have those tools available to me. Why on earth would you limit knowledge? The subscription already covers the cost. Its asinine. Someone explain the reasoning behind withholding information that could be useful in a journey to a sober life?  Edit: I disagree with denying members supplemental resources at their own discretion. I understand laying a framework that progresses from beginner to advanced- but that also assumes that we are all starting at the same place and level of experience with understanding and navigating addiction.   Not giving those of us who already are familiar with some aspects of recover (but have gaps of knowledge in other places) access to those resources leaves me wanting.   Gamifying sobriety isn’t an aspect of this app that I can appreciate. Other than that I support the methods being presented. SMART recovery.

Why don’t they have this for everything? — This is a really useful and incredible tool for anyone doing any mental health work or anyone that just wants to be a MINDFUL drinker. I wasn’t looking to fully become sober, but cut down on my drinking, track it, and become more aware of it after some recent incidents. This app is so worth it. I’ve told all my friends about it and health care workers so they can spread the word. I really can’t believe we live in such a culture where drinking is so common and so prevalent but SO. BAD. FOR. US. Anyways, kudos to who developed it. I’m grateful.

The best, most important, app I’ve ever purchased — I’ve had a rocky relationship with alcohol over the past couple of years and recently have been curious about cutting back, or even quitting. I tried a few times but, without support, fell back into my old habits after a few days.   With this app, I have been successful. It gives me the tools I need for success. The fact that it’s so science-based and focuses on why we drink is great.   If you’re curious, get this app. You’ll save well more than this app costs by not buying alcohol anymore!

Not AA…BETTER for people like me — Didn’t think an app would have enough to help me quit alcohol…until Reframe. I have no words to describe how invaluable the tools provided have helped me quit alcohol completely. Supportive and more informative than I EVER imagined. The science behind what alcohol does to the human body backs EVERYTHING on the app. And the community is unsurpassed. I have “friends” all over the world now. If you are questioning your relationship with drinking, try it out. You have nothing to lose…but you might get your life back better than ever!

Reframe Review! — For the price of what I used to spend on ONE NIGHT of drinks out, I have a comprehensive tool to improve my health, relationships and work career. That’s a bargain!      Reframe is a solid, no nonsense approach to a baffling, multifaceted problem. It allows me to maintain focus on healing, without being preachy or judgmental.       Nothing will work for everyone. It’s just not that simple. However, once a person makes the decision to pursue a positive change in their life by facing their alcohol problem, this app is a very powerful ally to help achieve that goal!      5 stars, all day long!

Read this — Reframe definitely has solid content. The app functionality is subpar for what you pay. I had issues from the start and after 9 days of trying to troubleshoot, I gave up. They use a third party tech support that is less than helpful. They also have a guarantee refund, but if you read the fine print, you gotta challenge thru your bank. Lastly, the helpful content they give you is in 3 min increments daily. I feel they are a 70/30 split of making money and helping. Lastly, they charge 50-70$ more if you want more help than what’s included. Reframe could be the next evolution in helping, but, at least in my experience it is about making money from vulnerable persons

Yes…do it — I have been struggling for years with casual drinking and being ok.  But after Covid I have been drinking and gambling way to much…and I seem to be more attracted to the behaviors that make me feel terrible about myself.  This program… in 1week has enlightened me to be more focused on myself and to focus more on what a alcohol free life can be. The science behind this program is very simple and interesting. Thank you for a program that speaks to me as a professional that I do not have to go to a meeting. It is in the palm of my hand and in my private time.

Do it — If you want to quit drinking or cut back this is the app. I am 6 months alcohol free after using it. It has daily lessons that are science based and make sense. There’s a forum you can post on and read what others are going through. And they have meetings every day where you can hear from others who are going through the same thing as you and you can share but only if you want to! I really can’t recommend it enough and I don’t think I’d have made it this far without this community

Nothing but upsides — I am so glad I signed up with Reframe a few months ago. I was growing increasingly less comfortable with my alcohol use but wasn’t really sure how to approach it. Reframe really helped me feel empowered and confident with my relationship to drinking. I am now very clear about who is in the driver’s seat! In three months I have cut down my total drinks by at least half, and have way more nights that I go without drinking at all. As an added bonus I am sleeping more soundly and my anxiety is definitely decreased as well.  Thanks Reframe Team!

Week = Excellent — After only 1 week this app still keeping me motivated/engaged It’s just enough to educate & motivate while tracking consumption.  I hate food journaling, but this was/is easier: you don’t have to bother with what you drank or when (at in the 1st 2 weeks) so it’s super easy.  For 5 mins of effort the return is obvious.  It keeps me honest to myself - what else matters when changing habits or dieting or drinking less.  My goal is reduction not quitting, so I can’t comment on its effectiveness for people trying to stop entirely.  Good Luck 😎👍

Truly is helpful and informative — I feel like it’s a taboo if you say you wanna ease up on drinking. People look at you like “OH, you must have a drinking problem”. But with this app, it has been very educational with driven scientific facts. A bonus it has a lot of helpful suggestions that can work for you individually. YOU can pick and choose!  It’s not just summed up as a hole. Because obviously everyone is different with different situations. I Thank everybody here for putting the time and effort but this wonderful app. together ❣️

Game changer for me — I love & appreciate this app. It has been helpful for me to check in. There’s many different aspects to this app to fine tune it to your needs & learn what works for you during this life journey. The forum is welcoming & no judgment. You can & ought to be honest to be true to yourself using the forum & all the different tools on here. If you’re here then I would highly suggest giving it a try. You have nothing to lose & all to gain. It’s funny, I’ve been on here since March & I don’t know how I found this app but I am ever grateful. Peace.

Educational App — Alcoholism runs in my family.  I wanted to find a source of information to understand it and offer better advice to loved ones who were struggling. Al Anon was not readily available and I wanted something easy to access. Reframe is the science of alcohol’s impacts on the human body and mind.  Learning why we like it, want more and the consequences is empowering.  This app teaches one to enjoy, control or quit alcohol.  I don’t think they teach this in AA.  I share this app with friends and family.  I enjoy a good white wine and will continue in moderation.

Wonderful Tool — I just started using Reframe a few days ago, in tandem with my return to an alcohol support group. The Reframe program is a great support to keep me motivated to stay dry. The daily tasks are engaging and informative. The application programming itself, is well thought out and intuitive. I plan to continue using Reframe as a companion to my support group, so that I have a strong toolkit to help me maintain my sobriety. I would encourage anyone who is curious about or activity participants in a sober lifestyle, to check Reframe out. (I give it two thumbs up!)

It’s definitely helping me! — I decided to do Dry January and felt that I needed some extra help if I was going to be successful. My friend told me about Reframe. It has been super-helpful! I’ve learned a lot about alcohol that I never knew-information that has helped me stay dry. Also, I’ve been impressed with the mood checks. Occasionally, Reframe checks you for depression and anxiety. I see a doctor for those things and I recognize the questions Reframe uses from my experience with him. This is a real high quality app. And it works!

Reframe !! — Ive been lost and clinched to alcohol for years, trying to find ways to stop myself from consuming as much as I did. I was unaware of the harm I was doing to my body until one day I came across Reframe. I’m not the usual type to pay after a free trial, but reframe changed that for me. When I’m on this app not only am I getting knowledge from alcohol intake and the severity of it , but I am also receiving so much support from everyone that uses this app. I’ve never felt so supported until I came across this app. I love reframe!

Evidence based — I love ReFrame because it centers around the scientific, medical and psychological aspects of problem drinking.  Given facts about why, understanding of the mechanisms involved makes the process of cutting down or quitting much easier.  No more believing I am powerless to change and must entreat “something greater than me” to allow me to change.  Reframe presents a set of tools that make sense to me and make it easier to effect change.  The bottom line though, is you have to want to change or nothing will work.

Just what I needed. — I’ve struggled for about a decade to meditate drinking. When I realized I may need to stop I tried and failed after a month. I didn’t have the tools to get through the social pressures.l and cravings. This app’s science-backed daily readings, activities, trackers, and support groups have absolutely solved that problem. My life has completely changed in every aspect: work, personal, and spiritual. Not only that, it has paid for it self in the money I’ve saved from not drinking. This is a no brained if you want to quit.

If you’re even slightly questioning your drinking… — …then download this app. This is my first app review but I can’t think of a more useful and educational tool I’ve ever had around alcohol. This is the education we all should receive in school. I’m 100 days sober and this app and the community forum feature have been a huge part of that. I started out on the cutback track but after learning more about alcohol through this app I decided to completely cut it out and it’s literally the best decision I’ve ever made for myself.

Sneaky!!! — I’m going to reluctantly flatter the developers for succeeding at giving the “appearance” of a wholesome, safe environment. But 9 days after purchasing I noticed that the forum is moderated by patronizing, cliche-driven fake “support”. The real drive of the app is to push 1-1 coaching and additional classes. Comments are filtered. Nothing debatable exists in the forums. Very few people are actually posting or discussing real life issues. The app is an insult to my intelligence. It completely lacks transparency. There is no way to contact the developer with questions. There’s no email provided. The educational aspect is well-done but requires you read only a little a day. You can not jump ahead and keep going in the learning process. Looks pretty but ends up being a disappointment.

A godsend — I’m only on day three of using this app, but so far it’s the only thing that’s actually made me stop drinking. I’ve been unbearably stressed over the last couple of months after losing my job and being unable to find another one, and I’ve been drinking heavily every night. My  drinking problems, like most people’s, began very gradually over time—so gradually that I didn’t realize it was turning into an actual problem until a few months ago. I’d say I’ve been a relatively heavy drinker for a couple years now, mostly from the stress of working in the hospitality industry during covid, and it’s just gotten so much worse the last couple of months.   I’ve tried therapy sessions, AA just isn’t my thing right now since most meetings are virtual and I just cannot get into it, but this app has helped me not drink a single drop of alcohol for two whole days. It might seem small to some, but for me it’s a huge deal. I’ve had cravings here and there, but I’ve been using the craving mode in the Reframe toolbox when they surface, and so far I’ve been successful in not even considering going to the liquor store. I’ve not yet arrived at a point in my addiction where I’m experiencing any of the physical effects of withdrawal—it’s pretty much all psychological at this point—so if that’s your case then this app may not be enough for you, I’m not sure. All I know is, I’ve woken up feeling great instead of hungover and groggy two mornings in a row, and it’s truly all thanks to this app.   I was skeptical about the price per month at first, but the $25 I’ve spent thus far has already saved me that much or more in the cost of alcohol I probably would’ve bought were it not for downloading Reframe. For now I’m trying to just cut back significantly on my drinking to get it down to what’s considered safe by national health guidelines. I’m highly confident I can make it to the end of the week without giving in, which is the goal I’ve set on the app. There are tons of features that have kept me engaged and motivated, and I haven’t even explored them all yet. It’s almost like therapy without the shame and fear of judgement that inevitably comes with disclosing one’s problems to a person face to face, and it’s always a few clicks away in my pocket whenever I need it. So very grateful I found Reframe! I highly recommend it, whether you’re a gray area drinker or a heavy drinker like myself. Time to stop wasting away my body and making more time for what’s important.

It works! — I love this app. It’s so engaging that I actually look forward to my Reframe time each day. And most importantly, it works.  There are support options for abstaining completely or just cutting back. I’m on my 15th consecutive day without alcohol coming off of a long run of pretty regular use. I don’t intend to stay dry forever, but I have confidence that I will be able to enjoy alcohol in moderation with the tools, techniques and mindset I’m learning from this app. Take back your power and live to your full potential with Reframe!

Theory & Praxis — This app is incredible. It uses evidence based practices and includes personal experiences to help build a model for alcohol use disorders that actually works. I learn something new daily and there are a myriad other tools that aid in my ability to cease alcohol consumption completely. At Reframe they don’t advocate or enforce abstinence only and (for some reason) this has helped me completely abstain! From meditations, breathing exercises, therapy, games, to classes this app is the only one I need on my road to healing from alcohol use spectrum disorder. I am so grateful.

Amazing app — This app provides motivation to stay sober on multiple levels. I love the daily readings and tasks that give me an education on alcohol and how I relate to it. Even after going through AA, an outpatient program, and individual therapy, I am still finding new information and new understanding on why certain CBT tasks are beneficial. The readings and tasks are locked until you complete days so it’s always a new surprise to see what to focus on. I also like that the coping strategies are all in one place and that there is the ability to connect to a community.

Accountability — After years of beating myself up and poor decisions, I decided to try the Reframe app. My goal was to cut back, which I’ve tried to do on my own many times without much success. The guidance the app gives you along with articles and a variety of support communities based on who you are has opened my eyes to how I can change my relationship with alcohol. I feel that the Reframe app and the daily tasks hold me accountable for the decisions I make on a daily basis. Daily note to self: Let’s do this!

Reframe your whole!! — The app is not just about cutting back on alcohol. It’s about giving you a new perspective on the decisions that you make day today and how you navigate life. Help you look at past patterns of behavior that have a negative impact hence the name of the app Reframe.  I think it’s great.  Each day there are small tasks that keep you motivated and focusing on the baby steps that you’re working towards making real change in your life.   The material covers all aspects and some topics are revisited to reinforce learning because you may not be focusing on that negative information on that day.  There’s a great discussion supporting one another. There’s challenges to keep you motivated and just good sessions about life.  I also like that some of the readings have dictation, which is beneficial because sometimes reading gets exhausted and I just wanna hear the material drinking coffee.

Probably the best investment in myself I’ve made — Reframe has wholly changed me. My relationship to alcohol is forever different. I knew I wanted to adopt a fully healthy lifestyle and cut back on anything that could affect my mental clarity and when I found Reframe I didn’t know what to expect. I wanted to cut way back on drinking and have found I may not do it much at all. I no longer need it to unwind after a long and tough day. I work through those feelings mindfully and focus more on emotional regulation through DBT and other modalities of mindfulness.

False 60-day money back guarantee — They expect you to use the app every day for 60 days to get your money back. They didn’t state this explicitly at the time. Don’t try it if you think you could miss a day in your busy schedule while trying to change habits. In the end, I was getting the help I needed from other places, and the app wasn’t something I needed as much. I thought if I didn’t find it useful in 60 days I’d just stop using the app, but they’re not giving me a refund now.  This refund is a complete scam. I was charged $30/month and now they’re saying it is the app stores fault when they explicitly told me it is because I didn’t use it for 60 days straight. Please stop lying to us even in your app review response. Thank you.

Reframe is worth every penny! — If you want to cut back on or completely eliminate alcohol, this app is a great start. It’s really easy to use and extremely informative. I didn’t want to eliminate completely - just cut back - but this app keeps me on track. There are a lot of tips to help with cravings, a goal tracker, and outside assistance with other users in the forum. I have had the app for less than two weeks, and it will pay for itself within another week. I am beginning to see and feel positive results!

Exactly what I needed — This app helps guide you.  It doesn’t tell you. Everyone’s relationship with alcohol is different.  It has helped me reflect on my decisions to use alcohol as a crutch and how to move past my triggers.  I have stopped drinking for periods of time, but find myself right back where I started.  Drinking too much and not feeling well.  When I started this app to “decrease my drinking”. I found that what they were saying was exactly what I was thinking.  I always felt alone with my struggles with Alcohol, now I don’t

Very Helpful — If you are in a spot in life, like I had been, where obsessing about having that next wine, or beer, or rum & coke is the most important thing in life right now, the app could be the trigger needed to bring you compassion for yourself, kindness & forgiveness for yourself because you now understand that you are not a bad person - it’s biological science that has hijacked your brain.  And the good news is, you can get out of the loop, like I have.  I strongly recommend you give this a chance.  It worked for me.

Finally Free~ — Reframe is a dynamic low pressure app for those seeking to change their relationship with alcohol. I am impressed with all the avenues for support including the sober curious. You can hang solo, listen to group meetings or podcasts, self monitor, connect with coaches, and share with others on similar journeys towards better health. The app is a fabulous tool for anyone who just takes the chance to try something different. I haven’t had any alcohol for 6 weeks  and much of my success so far is this amazing resource. 😎

Love this app and continue to use it daily — I've been using reframe for multiple years.  I initially signed on looking for recuction, and finally decided to leave alcohol behind a long time ago.  I still learn something every single day I use the app, and of course it's gone well beyond anything to do with alcohol which is the underpinning of it's success: it's about personal growth that happens to result in less dependence on substances.  It's worth doing, and then continuing to do after any desired outcome with alcohol is achieved.

Disappointing — I had trouble initially logging in when I first downloaded the app and had to remake my profile several times. Once I downloaded it, I tried to log my drinks and it won’t save my information. When I tried to set the weekly baseline it also would not save. I tried restarting my phone and nothing changed. This has been over several weeks I tried to get it to work and I’m a patient person, but it’s not saving my information and it’s very disappointing that I paid for an app to help me reach my goals and it is just a source of frustration. I had my fiancé who works in tech check it and said I have everything set correctly and it should work. Very disappointed, do not recommend.

Daily wine at night….creeping up on me — That glass of wine in the evening to relax and reward myself for the day developed into two and then sometimes three. It began to worry me. I didn’t want to become more dependent or addicted and didn’t want the health risks either. I didn’t think I needed to never drink again so wanted support to sort this out and cut back, way back. Reframe does that. Learning more through daily readings and setting goals has been exactly what I needed! Feeling better already after just 2 weeks.

Helping me reach my goals — I have found this app instrumental in helping me start my cut back journey. I still have work to do but I could not have taken the first step (reaching for the wine bottle without even thinking) if it wasn’t for the readings and the trackers in this app.  I highly recommend using this app if you are serious about starting your journey. You will be able to see your progress. You will be holding yourself account for your choices. You will be able to celebrate your wins.

Factual and non-shaming! — I’ve always known that my relationship with alcohol was a risky one. Sometimes I could control my consumption, other times would lead to blacking out and making mistakes. I’ve tried to reduce my use many times, but finally was confronted with it not being the route for me.   Since using reframe I’ve been alcohol free (coming from 4 drinks a day)! This app has encouraged me and empowered me in ways I never would have believed! It’s all fact base, never using shame or higher power language, and gives space for you to tackle this journey in whatever way you see fit (cutting back, being alcohol free, etc.).   The forum feature offers community when you feel stuck and the reflection features give space to better understanding alcohols role in your life.   100% the best thing I did when my therapist advised me to go to AA. Instead I’ve done reframe!

Useful but too expensive — I like this app. The reading content is useful and informative and gives me something to chew on as far as to my “why” and the little games in the “craving” section are a good distraction technique. But this is just too expensive for a recovery app. It’s almost elitist.  Also, the forums seem very edited. Every response is written the same tone of voice with no spelling errors or individual personality, which makes the overall  feel  of forum “interactivity” manufactured (IMO.)  I did not try the coaching though. I just wish this was less expensive.

Reframe — Excellent program to help me cut back my drinking. The neuroscience behind alcohol and the brain is explained clearly. I have learned valuable, useful information that has been instrumental in my journey. The feedback and support I have found through the app is beyond anything I expected. Response to technical questions are answered quickly and input from the client community is taken seriously which is very helpful. Give this app a try as I did, you will not regret it. Literally, it has changed my life.

Great idea but too inefficient for me — Like many people I have a busy lifestyle with a lot of responsibilities between work, family, etc.  This app requires too much constant attention and felt like another chore on the days I did use it. Because of this chore feeling there were many days I ignored the app over the last 10 months I’ve been subscribed. After a period of days or weeks not paying attention to the app, I logged back in and the app had just made the assumption that I had not had a drink for all those days. It falsely claims over the last several months I have saved thousands of dollars and had had over 300 days under my drink limit - Ha

Awesome for any one trying to cut back or quit alcohol — This is so much better than AA! Can also supplement AA. So much information and so so much support in this app! It teaches you all the neuroscience of why and how we do what we do along with all the latest data on how to slow down or stop. Love that their are so many daily meetings and a option for one on one! There are tons of articles, meditation, places for writing personal thoughts and experiences. They left no stone unturned. Well worth the investment for your health. Great community.

Life changing — This app tackles every angle possible basically to get you to comprehend the choices you are making everyday with alcohol and how they affect you mentally, physically, and behavior- wise. It uses science and easy to read, comprehensive information that is quickly absorbed and understood. The support of the community on the app is outstanding, there’s times I needed them and they were there! Quitting alcohol has never been easier and I’ve never felt more confident in my ability and choice to be alcohol free.

Excellent tool for quitting — Reframe is just the nudge I needed to start making better choices for my health. The daily tasks and tracking metrics are just the right amount of accountability for me, and I’ve found the investment in my time + the monthly fee is WELL compensated in improvements to my physical and mental health. The chat forum is a wonderful place to turn for anonymous community support and feedback on struggles and wins. Health insurance companies would save tons of money by offering a Reframe subscription to anyone who wants it, in my opinion.

Loving this app! — I am loving this app! I feel like I am becoming happier and healthier in so many areas of my life.  This app provides suggestions, coaching, videos, exercises and a wealth of information on what and how to thrive after cutting back or living alcohol free. When I need advice, motivation, knowledge or compassion I turn to this app. I have heard the saying that removing alcohol is the easy part. This app is great for helping people deal with what comes after. I am using it to help me organize and construct my life into what I would like it to be.

Very helpful tool — I was an AA member 12 years ago and was sober for 4 years. Sobriety changed my lofe but then I stopped attending meetings and started gradually drinking again. I've considered going back to meetings over the years but have felt some trepidation. I found reframe and it's helped me understand cognitively how drinking harms me (AA helped me have a loved experience of sobriety and helped me find a community of like minded sober friends. Aa is invaluable). I feel that reframe fills in the gaps in my learn and resolve to stop drinking, it has helped, too! Def recommended this app!

Thank god for this app — On my ninth day of sobriety after tackling my drinking habits and the problems from over, drinking often on for years with no lasting success, this app gives me knowledge and motivation to stay on course and understand my difficulties, and give me great reasons to stop drinking. If I do drink again in the future, it would be a completely different relationship and never will be a daily drinker again in my life. Thank you to all the good people who worked to create this transformative tool.

Powerful Recovery App — Reframe gets it right in so many ways.  From availability of meetings , tools, ability to create groups, daily tasks. Challenges, etc, this is an excellent space to work on relationship with alcohol.   I did use a coach, she was superb in every way. I would urge reframe to solicit feedback from members frequently, and, to make sure chat moderators are focusing on alcohol usage within all topics, and, refraining from presenting diagnoses of any kind as chat topics.  I feel very grateful for this App, it has helped me make progress that I had determined wasn’t even possible

It works — This app is amazing. I’m 30 days sober and I am 100% sure it’s because of this app. I do engage (at least) daily, complete all daily tasks and visit the forum. I work in healthcare but have learned so much from this app. I now know that I was a grey zone drinker. High functioning, I was never going to hit “rock bottom”, but I could not seem to quit. The pull was too strong. 30 days later, I am happier and healthier then ever. I’m more productive, sleep better and present with my children. Sober life is the best! ❤️ thank you reframe

Great tool - for any level of cutting back — I have found this app to be easy to use, educational, motivating, and habit-forming in the most positive, beneficial way.   From my perspective, the content could be helpful and engaging for any degree of cutting back, from a slight reduction in consumption to full abstinence.   The daily tasks and toolkit are just do well thought out and offer great positive reinforcement. I tend to stray from it after a while, but found it valuable enough to pay for a subscription for two years now.

A new start ❤️ — I was berating myself constantly for not being able to moderate my drinking. I really love the flexibility that this app has given me, and the information on the science behind the effects of alcohol.    It also encourages me to treat myself compassionately while untangling the negative effects that alcohol has had on my life.     I am currently about 80 days alcohol free, and have successfully chosen to have a few drinks here and there. This seems like it would have been impossible previously. Thank you, Reframe!

Very impressed — I have to say this app has blown me away. Not only has it actually helped me cut back on alcohol but they have made it so user friendly and actually enjoyable to use. I am so so happy I decided to give this a try, it’s exactly what I needed as someone feeling the desire to re-evaluate my relationship with alcohol. The app is psychology based and provides education, journal entries, classes, workshops, a community forum, meditation, and really so much more. I am excited to continue with my reframe journey and share with others!

My favorite app, ever! — For those of us who respond to a more open, individualized approach to cutting back on or quitting alcohol, this app is fantastic.  It holds you accountable to yourself and is informative, encouraging and very user friendly.   I was skeptical at first, but I really enjoy this app and it’s been indispensable on my journey back to better health.  I’ve also had a few questions along the way, and they’re extremely responsive and personable.  Just a very positive experience that puts me in a great “frame” of mind.

Powerful and different — Perfect sobriety (or cutback) guide for someone factor science based. Great for me because I’m not religious and AA isn’t really a suitable option for me. The forum and community is truly the most beneficial aspect of this app. We keep one another accountable, offer recommendations or advice, and support one another. Before, when I quit, it was from a place of anger or resentment that I couldn’t be “normal”. This app focuses on how normal you are, and shifts thinking to the positive components of cutting back or abstinence. Would recommend 100x over.

Reframe is a Great App — With the Reframe App I have cutback my drinking with the hope of going alcohol free for the first time in 15+ years of daily drinking. I have tried to quit many times on my own but the science behind reframe really made the connection for me. The cravings are less and feel like I am on a positive trajectory for the first time in many years. I’ve only used the app for a week and chose to actually purchase it based on the progress I made in that one week. I will keep using it daily. Thanks Reframe!!

CHANGED. MY. LIFE. — This app is great for anyone re-thinking their relationship with alcohol. It gives you real facts about the effects of alcohol on your body and brain, as well as strategies you can use immediately in your daily life. There’s access to a community of people including tons of daily meeting options led by credentialed moderators. This is NOT a 12-step program, and can easily be integrated into any lifestyle or identification along the alcohol use spectrum. It has literally changed my life since day one.

Review — I love the Forum aspect of this program helps me to know I am not alone and there are many others out there that are going through the same thing. The daily checklist is awesome works well with accountability and the information information is extremely helpful and useful  I love the ability to be anonymous if I choose too.   The tracker for days on program sleep $ saved is all great.   Has helped me to view this in a different way so that I don’t have to feel ashamed.

Best app! — I've been doing this up for a couple of months now. It is truly an amazing! It has helped me significantly, and I love all the tools that are at my disposal. I look forward to doing my daily tasks and reading through the forum. There are meditations, podcasts, support groups, ideas and helpful insights, motivations. Whoever put this together did a fabulous job. There is something in this app for everyone whatever and wherever they may be in their journey. If I could get more than five stars I would!

Exactly what I needed to regain control — I’m so thankful I stumbled across Reframe!! After Covid, my alcohol consumption took on a life of its own. I knew it was a problem, but every day would be the same……I would drink, and oftentimes more than I should.   With Reframe, the truth is exposed-that alcohol is a neurotoxin, and it’s not entirely my fault for what I was doing. That truth and Reframe’s education about the body, mind, brain chemicals etc. gave me the knowledge I needed to start making small positive changes.  I started by reducing first, and that felt so good that I’m now working on 30 days alcohol free!   I am still learning new things for my overall health. It’s like a wise friend walking along with me on my journey. I feel much more in control of my drinking!  This has all come about by investing in the Reframe app. Being in control and living a healthier lifestyle is worth it!!   THANKS REFRAME!!

Has potential, needs some work — Perhaps if I were 20 years younger, my review would be a little higher, as I feel like this app is very much geared to a younger audience.   Initially, I found the daily tasks helpful as they focused on the science of why one drinks in excess. As the modules moved more to emotional effects of drinking, it seemed like the advice was very much geared to the 20-30-something crowd. The recovery stories in the daily tasks are all young which is great if you are young, but not relatable as a person who is middle aged and beyond. Also, some of the advice columns offered what seemed to be very pat answers to complex issues - that needs some work.  The forum was great - lots of very supportive people going through the same challenges. I also liked the trackers for the money and calories I was saving by not drinking.   Clearly, this is an app designed by younger people for younger people - and as I said, a younger person battling alcohol dependence will probably find this a useful sobriety tool.

The why behind bad habits — I really enjoy the perspective brought by the Reframe app. You don’t need to label your relationship with alcohol. You can also be human and have a deviation from your plan without losing all of your progress. Rather, Reframe helps you be more compassionate to yourself and understand the ‘whys’ driving our patterns - beyond bad or good. I was seeking support in changing how I socialize and how I balance stress. If you are curious about what your life would be like without alcohol, Reframe is a fantastic place to help!

Backed by research and science — I love that the app has a cutback track and an alcohol free track for anyone looking to change how alcohol is showing up in their life.  There are daily tasks, toolkit, discover tab, meetings, a posting forum, as well as coaches. I haven’t been able to cutback very well on my own, but by committing about 15/minutes a day on the app, I’ve cut my alcohol by 50%, lost weight, reduced stressed, sleeping better, and saved more than the annual membership costs. Highly recommend and  best wishes on your journey.

1 Year Sober - Life Changing and Life Saving App — I love this app so very much!! I’m not sure if I can add anything more than the other reviews, but this app (and working the ACoA 12 step program) saved my life. I can’t recommend it enough. Initially I got the free trial of the app in November 2021 because of the Instagram ads and figured why not, after a few months of working through the app and some rough holidays I then promised myself I’d do dry January 2022, and now its January 2023 and I’m celebrating a YEAR sober and counting. Thank you for this app!!

A fun, authentic way to learn, be inspired + check in with myself daily! — I LOVE reframe! I didn’t join as an epic drinker, but I wanted to learn about how alcohol affects my body + brain. I did the free month, then immediately signed up for the year. I find this such a fun, inspiring, educational way to stay focused on living my best life! I think of Reframe as my mini life coach. I dive deeper myself into some topics + fly through others, but the diversity of topics from health, relationships, mindfulness, self love, psychological concepts - are sooo great to learn about!! Thank you!

Happy customer! — I’ve never been one to commit to a program; however, I have found myself checking in with this app daily. If it weren’t for reframe, the daily tasks, and the wonderful support offered by others, I wouldn’t be 26 days alcohol free today. This is the longest I’ve gone without drinking in years! I’m soo proud of myself and I wouldn’t have been able to do it without this app. I just paid for the 1 year membership and I’m so happy that I found reframe. Thank you!

Works for me! — Reframe continually surprises me with the quality of the information it gives me about the effects of alcohol on the various organs of the body (including the brain). I believe it’s getting me to rethink (okay, “reframe”) how I think about alcohol so I see the whole picture. I’ve been to AA, SMART, read books, but, for me, Reframe has the tools (meetings, tasks to make me think, seminars, reminders), encouragement, availability and seriousness that work for me. These folks have put together literally, a life-changing app.

Lack of app support — The community and the learnings have been life saving without question.  I will be critical of recent changes to the app where the flow of the daily work is being interrupted by disruptive requests for app feedback every single day. Imagine you’re reading a book and as soon as you turn the page, someone comes by and closes the book, gets in you face and won’t give you the book back until you tell them how the last page was.  Every single day. Support has responded “we’re trying to fix it”. This has been going on for months to no avail.

Worth every penny — I rarely write reviews but if someone is looking for resources to help change their relationship with alcohol do try this app. It’s helped me stay alcohol free for 50 days.   You can learn so much about alcohol misuse/dependence through a scientific lens that helps shed the mysticism and shame attached. There are mini actionable suggestions each day that really build up to make a long term difference.  There’s also a sympathetic community moderated by experts and coaches that helps you feel less alone and helpless. I find the meetings to be really helpful, I listen in anonymously (haven’t felt up to share yet but want to one day) and find what people share to be inspiring and empowering. It’s helped me become less judgmental toward myself.  A giant thank you to the developers, you’re making a product that’s truly making a positive difference.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ — With so many apps out there I took a chance on Reframe and was not disappointed.  As of today I’m 30 days alcohol free and counting. I’m so impressed with the tools the app provides.  The daily tasks, community forums, zoom meetings,tools for meditation, cravings, and science knowledge behind the affects of alcohol.  No judgment within the Reframe community whether your journey is to cut back or go alcohol free.  I’m so happy to find Reframe for my journey to a better healthier lifestyle.  Download this app if you’re serious about changing your lifestyle!

Informative & helpful — I first purchased Reframe when I wanted to reduce my consumption; like any tool, we get out of it what we put into it.  The first few weeks I was merely tracking my drinks, not really digging into the daily reading.  After a break, I found I wanted to come back to the application and seriously make better progress.  The more I check in with Reframe daily, the better my results.   There is information presented in many forms , scientific, holistic, and includes useful meditations.

Love this app! — I’ve been using it for 3 days and wow I feel so different. I’ve been able to manage my urges to drink and even to over eat. I love the zoom meetings. They showed me how im not alone on this journey. I love all the Ted talks that are available that help you understand how addiction works. Super Helpful! — This app has been more helpful than I anticipated.  I signed up for the free trial and decided to purchase the subscription.  It has so many tools to help me on my cutback journey. Great app! — I signed up for this app because I wanted to decrease my intake of alcohol but didn’t realize the impact it did and continues to have. I Didn’t Want to Spend the Money — But—I’m so glad I did. Amazing App with an incredible community! — I can’t recommend Reframe enough. It is worth every penny of the $9.99/month. Life changing app that pays for itself in the first month — This app far exceeded my expectations. I thought it might help me cut down a bit on alcohol to complement my general fitness and weight management goals. It achieved this and more.   At the most basic level, Reframe will save you money. How would you feel about having an extra $200 a week in your pocket?  The app provides helpful check ins and enjoyable readings and activities that generally involve 5-10 minutes morning and evening. The material is carefully structured and includes videos from Reframe’s own team of coaches who have all been on their own recovery journeys.  But wait, there’s more. Lots more.  There is a community forum for extra support, there are monthly challenges, there are additional self-paced learning modules (for improving sleep, finding your life purpose, etc), journaling functionality with optional AI prompting and analysis, and individual progress is tracked and rewarded with encouraging comments and “recoins”.  Options within the app are also provided for real-time video coaching sessions, either with a group or 1:1. These are led by people who have a deep understanding of what alcohol does to our minds and bodies and why we are so drawn to it. The sessions are very reasonably priced and easy to book. The ONLY negative thing I have to say about the app is that all the coaches are in the US, so finding a suitable session time is difficult if you live in Australia.

One of my favorite features is the drink logging. I’m currently just shy of 5 months without a drink, and I feel so much healthier both physically and mentally. I also enjoy using some of the meditations regularly to kick off my workday and boost my self-esteem. They are a great addition to my routine. I realized that willpower alone wouldn’t get me there; I needed to recalibrate my thinking and reframe my mindset to the point where I simply didn’t want to drink. I’ve gained more tools to manage stress and build a fulfilling life.  As a result, the choice to drink or not rarely comes into question for me anymore.
